Mishneh Torah, Sabbatical Year and the J: Perot sheviit en ochlin mehen ella kol zeman sheoto hammin matzuy bassade shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 7)</small> "velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha tihye chol tevuatah leechl". kol zeman shechayya ochelet mimmin ze min hassade atta ochel mimma shebbabbayit. kala lachayya min hassade chayyav levaer oto hammin min habbayit vezehu biur shel perot sheviit:
Ketzad. hare shehayu lo gerogarot sheviit betoch beto ochel mehen kol zeman shehatteenim bailanot bassade. kalu hatteenim min hassade asur leechol meotan shebbabbayit ella mevaer otan:

Hayu lo perot merubbin mechallekan mezon shalosh seuddot lechol echad veechad. veasur leechol achar habbiur ben laaniyyim ben laashirim. veim lo matza ochlin bishat habbiur soref baesh o mashlich leyam hammelach umeabbedan lechol davar shemmeabbed:

Hayu lo tzimmukin shel sheviit. vechalu haanavim min hassade min haggaggot vehappardesim shehen hefker. af al pi sheadayin yesh anavim baggefanim shebbetoch hachatzerot eno ochel min hatztzimmukin mippene anavim ellu shebbechatzer. lefi sheenan metzuyin lachayya. aval im yesh anavim kashim beyoter sheenan nigmarin ella besof hashshana hare ze ochel min hatztzimmukin bishvilan. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ilan sheose perot shete peamim beshana vehayu lo mipperotav harishonot hare ze ochel mehen kol zeman shepperot sheniyyot metzuyot bassade. shehare meoto hammin bassade. aval perot hassetav en ochlim bishvilan. mippene sheddomin lapperot shel shana acheret:

Hakkovesh shelosha kevashim bechavit achat. kol shekkala mino min hassade yevaer mino min hechavit. veim hitchil bah hare hakkol kimvoar. ucheshem shemmevaer ochole adam kach mevaer ochole behema min habbayit. veeno maachilan livhema im kala oto hammin min hassade:

Ucheshem shemmevaarin et happerot kach mevaarin et haddamim. ketzad. hare shemmachar rimmonim shel sheviit vahare hu ochel bidmehen. vechalu harimmonim min hailanot shebbassade venishar etzlo min haddamim shemmachar bahen chayyav levaaran:
Ketzad ose. kone bahen. maachalot umechallekan mezon shalosh seuddot lechol echad veechad. o yashlichem leyam hammelach im lo matza ochlin:

Shalosh aratzot leviur. eretz yehuda kullah hahar vehashshefela vehaemek eretz achat. ever hayyarden kullo shiflat lud vehar shiflat lud umibbet choron im hayyam eretz achat. vehaggalil kullo haelyon vehattachton utechum teverya eretz achat. veochlin bechol achat veachat mishshelashtan ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbah:
Ketzad. hayu lo perot beeretz yehuda. ochel mehen kol zeman sheyyesh meoto hammin bechol eretz yehuda kullah. vechen im hayu lo perot galil. vechen beever hayyarden:

Veshalosh aratzot ellu kullan chashuvot keeretz achat lecharuvin ulezetim velitmarim. veochlin battemarim ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbetzoar. veematay hu kale. ad happurim. veochlin bezetim ad haatzeret. uvaanavim ad happesach shel motzae sheviit. uvigrogrot ad hachanukka:

Hammolich perot sheviit mimmakom shekkalu lemakom shello kalu o mimmakom shello kalu lammakom shekkalu chayyav levaer. lefi shennotnin alav chumre makom sheyyatza mishsham vechumre makom shehalach lesham. uferot haaretz sheyyatzu lechutza laaretz mitbaarim bimkoman velo yaavirem mimmakom lemakom:

Kelal gadol amru bashsheviit kol shehu maachal adam o maachal behema o mimmin hatztzovin im eno mitkayyem baaretz yesh lo uledamav sheviit vechayyav beviur hu vedamav. kegon ale halluf hashshote vaale haddandanna vehaelshin maachal adam. uchegon hachochim vehaddardarin maachal habbehema. uchegon istis vekotza mimmin hatztzovin. veim haya mitkayyem baaretz kegon happua veharichpa mimmin hatztzovin af al pi sheyyesh lo sheviit uledamav sheviit en lahem biur velo lidmehem shehare mitkayyem baaretz ella nehenin vetzovin bo ad rosh hashshana:

Vechol sheeno meyuchad lo lemaachal adam velo lemaachal behema veeno mimmin hatztzovim. hoil veeno leetzim yesh lo uledamav sheviit. aval en lahem biur af al pi sheeno mitkayyem baaretz ella nehenin bo o bedamav ad rosh hashshana kegon ikkere halluf hashshote veikkar haddandanna vehaakrevanin:

Kelippe rimmon vehannetz shello kelippe egozim vehaggarinin yesh lahem sheviit velidmehem sheviit aval en lahem biur velo lidmehem. luleve zeradim vehecharuvim yesh lahem velidmehem sheviit uviur. luleve haela vehabbatna vehaatadin yesh lahen velidmehen sheviit aval en lahem biur. aval lealim shellahen yesh biur:
Ezo hi sheat biur healin beet sheyyibbolu venoshrin meilanotehen. ale zetim vaale kanim vaale charuvin en lahem biur lefi sheenan novlot vechalot:
Vead matay yihye adam rashshay lilkot asavim lachin bashsheviit ad sheyyivash hammatok vigabbev. asavim yeveshim ad shettered revia sheniyya bemotzae sheviit:
Vead matay yihyu haaniyyim muttarin lehikkanes befardesot bemotzae sheviit leissuf perot sheviit. ad shettered revia sheniyya:
Havvered vehakkofer vehallotem yesh lahen velidmehen sheviit. hakketaf vehu saraf hayyotze mehailanot min healim umehaikkarim en lo sheviit. vehayyotze min happaggim yesh lo uledamav sheviit:
Bamme devarim amurim beilan maachol. aval beilan serak af hayyotze min healin umin haikkarim kifri shellahen veyesh lo uledamav sheviit:

Hakkovesh vered sheviit beshemen shel shishshit yelakket et havvered vehashshemen muttar. kevasho beshemen shel motzae sheviit chayyav levaer hashshemen shehare havvered yavesh hu uchevar nitchayyev beviur:

Charuvin shel sheviit shekkevashan beyen shishshit o beyen motzae sheviit chayyav levaer hayyayin. shehare taam perot sheviit bo. ze hakkelal perot sheviit shennitarvu beferot acherot min bemino bechol shehu veshello bemino benoten taam:

Kederech sheasur laavod haaretz bashsheviit kach asur lechazzek yede yisrael sheovdin otah. o limkor lahen kele avoda. lefi sheasur lechazzek yede ovre avera: 
Veellu kelim sheen haumman rashshay lemachran bashsheviit lemi shechashud al hashsheviit. machresha vechol keleha haol vehammazzere vehaddeker. ze hakkelal kol shemmelachto meyuchedet limlacha sheasura bashsheviit asur lemachro lechashud. velimlacha sheefshar shettihye asura vetihye mutteret muttar lemachro lechashud: 
Ketzad. mocher hu lo hammaggal vehaagala vechol keleha. sheim yiktzor bo meat veyavi al haagala meat hare ze muttar. veim yiktzor kederech hakkotzrin o yavi kol perot sadehu asur: 
Umuttar limkor setam lemi sheeno chashud afillu davar shemmelachto meyuchedet limlacha haasura bashsheviit. shehare efshar shekkana bashsheviit laasot lo melacha leachar sheviit: 
Hayyotzer mocher chamesh kade shemen vachamishsha asar kadde yayin. umuttar limkor leakkum yeter mizze veeno choshesh shemma yimkor leyisrael. umocher kaddim rabbim leyisrael bechutza laaretz veeno choshesh shemma yeviem laaretz: 
Umocher lechashud para choreshet bashsheviit shehare efshar leshochotah. umocher lo sadehu shehare efshar sheyyovirah. aval lo yimkor lo sede hailan ella im ken pasak immo al menat sheen lo bailan. umashilo sea limdod bah af al pi shehu yodea sheyyesh lo goren shehare efshar sheyyimdod bah betoch beto. uforet lo maot af al pi shehu yodea sheyyesh lo poalim. vechullan beferush asurim: 
Vechen mashelet ishsha lachavertah hachashuda al hashsheviit nafa uchevara rechayim vetannur. aval lo tavor velo titchon immah: 
Machazikin yede akkum bashsheviit bidvarim bilvad. kegon sheraahu choresh o zorea omer lo titchazzek o tatzliach vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. mippene sheenam metzuvvin al shevitat haaretz. aval lo yesaaddenu bayyad. umuttar lirdot immahen hakkavveret vechochrin mehen nirin lefi sheenan bene chiyyuv kede liknos otan: 
Muttar laasot besureya betalush aval lo bamchubbar. ketzad. dashin vezorin vedorchin umeammerin. aval lo kotzrin velo botzrin velo moskin. vechen kol kayyotze beellu: 
Keshem sheasur laasot sechora beferot sheviit o leshamran kach asur likkach meam haaretz. lefi sheen mosrin deme sheviit leam haaretz. vaafillu kol shehu. shemma lo yochal otan bikdushshat sheviit: 
Hallokeach lulav meam haaretz bashsheviit noten lo etrog mattana. veim lo natan lo mavlia lo deme etrog bidme lulav: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman shehaya mocher perot shekkemotan beshamur kegon teenim verimmonim vechayyotze bahen. aval haya mocher perot shechezkatan min hahefker kegon happegam vehayyarbuzin vehashshotim vehachalaglogot vehakkusbar shel harim vechayyotze bahen hare ze muttar likkach mimmennu meat kidme shalosh seuddot bilvad mishshum kede chayyav shel mocher: 
Vechol davar sheeno chayyav bemaasrot kegon shum baal bechi uvatzal shel richpa ugerisin hakkilkiyyot vaadashim hammitzriyyot vechen zerone ginna sheenan neechalot kegon zera lefet utzenon vechayyotze bahen hare ellu nilkachin mikkol adam bashsheviit: 
Bamme devarim amurim beam haaretz setam. aval mi shehu chashud laasot sechora beferot sheviit o lishmor perotav velimkor mehen en lokchin mimmennu davar sheyyesh alav zikkat sheviit kelal. veen lokchin mimmennu pishtan afillu saruk. aval lokchin mimmennu tavuy veshazur: 
Hechashud al hashsheviit eno chashud al hammaasrot. vehechashud al hammaasrot eno chashud al hashsheviit. sheaf al pi shezze veze min hattora. maaser taun havaat makom ma sheen ken bashsheviit. usheviit en lah pidyon ma sheen ken bemaaser: 
Hechashud al hattohorot eno chashud lo al hammaaser velo al hashsheviit. shehaochel hattame hazze shemmecharo bechezkat tahor eno metamme acherim ella middivre sofrim. vehechashud ledivre sofrim eno chashud ledivre tora: 
Kol hechashud al davar af al pi sheeno neeman al shel atzmo neeman hu al shel acherim chazaka en adam chote laacherim. lefichach hechashud al haddavar dano umeido: 
Hakkohanim chashudin al hashsheviit lefi shehem omrim hoil vehatterumot muttarot lanu af al pi shehen asurin al hazzarim bemita kal vachomer perot sheviit. lefichach sea teruma shennafla lemea sea shel perot sheviit taale. nafla lefachot mimmea yerakvu hakkol velo yimmachru lakkohanim kechol medumma lefi shehem chashudin al hashsheviit: 
Hatztzavanin vehappattamin lokchin mursan mikkol makom. veenan choshshin shemma missefiche sheviit hu: 
Gabbae kuppa bashsheviit lo yihyu medakdekin bachatzerot shel ochlin sheviit. veim natnu lahen pat mutteret veen choshshin lah shemma missefiche sheviit hu. shello nechshedu yisrael lihyot notnin ella o meot sheviit o betzim hannilkachot bidme sheviit. umuttar lilvot min haaniyyim perot sheviit umachzirin lahen perot beshana sheminit:

Mitzvat ase lehashemit hammalve bashsheviit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "shamot kol baal mashshe yado". vehattovea chov sheavra alav sheviit avar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "lo yiggosho et reehu veet achiv": 
En shemittat kesafim noheget min hattora ella bizman shehayyovel noheg sheyyesh sham shemittat karka. shehare yashuv hakkarka livalav belo kesef. vedavar ze kabbala hu. amru chachamim bizman sheatta meshammet karka atta meshammet kesafim bechol makom ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. uvizman sheen sham shemittat karka en atta meshammet kesafim bishviit afillu baaretz: 
Umiddivre sofrim shettehe shemittat kesafim noheget bazzeman hazze bechol makom veaf al pi sheen hayyovel noheg kede shello tishtakkeach torat shemittat hakkesafim miyyisrael: 
En sheviit meshammetet kesafim ella besofah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 1)</small> "mikketz sheva shanim taase" shemitta veze devar hashshemitta vesham hu omer <small>(Devarim lo 10)</small> "mikketz sheva shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot". ma sham achar sheva af hashematat kesafim achar sheva. lefichach hilva et chavero bashsheviit atzmah gove chovo kol hashshana. ucheshettishka chamma belele rosh hashshana shel motzae sheviit avad hachov: 
Shachat et happara vechillekah al daat shehayyom rosh hashshana shel motzae sheviit venitabber elul venimtza oto hayyom sof sheviit avdu haddamim. shehare avra sheviit al hachov: 
Sheviit meshammetet et hammilve vaafillu milve shebbishtar sheyyesh bo acharayut nechasim hare ze meshammet. veim siyyem lo sade behalevaato eno mashmit. vehashsheviit meshammetet et hashshevua shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "lo yiggsho" mikkol makom lo leshallem velo lehishshava: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishvuat haddayyanin vechol kayyotze bah middevarim sheim yode bahen sheviit meshammattan. aval shevuat hashshomrin vehashshuttafin vechayyotze bahen mishshavuot sheim yode yeshallem hare ze yishshava achar hashshemitta: 
Hilvahu utevao vechafar bo. vehiggia hashshemitta vehu bichfirato. vehoda achar sheavra sheviit. o shebbau alav edim achar hashsheviit en hashsheviit meshammetet: 
Hammalve et chavero vekava lo zeman leeser shanim eno meshammet. af al pi shehu ba lide <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "lo yiggsho" hare hu atta eno yachol lingosho. hitna immo shello yitbaennu sheviit meshammetet: 
Hammalve et chavero vehitna immo shello teshammetennu sheviit hare ze nishmat sheeno yachol levattel din hashsheviit. hitna immo shello yeshammet hu chov ze vaafillu bashsheviit tenao kayyam. shekkol tenay shebbemamon kayyam. venimtza ze chiyyev atzmo bemamon shello chiyyevattu tora shehu chayyav: 
Hakkafat hachanut enah nishmetet. veim asaah milve nishmetet. sechar sachir eno nishmat. veim zekafo alav bemilve nishmat: 
Kenasot shel ones veshel mefatte vehammotzi shem ra enam nishmatin. veim zekafan bemilve nishmatim. umeematay nizkafin bemilve mishsheat haamada baddin: 
Hamegaresh et ishto kodem hashshemitta en ketubbatah nishmetet. veim pegamtah o zekaftah alav bemilve nishmetet: 
Hammalve al hammashkon eno mashmit. vehu sheyyihye hachov keneged hammashkon. veim haya yeter mashmit hayyeter: 
Hammoser shitrotav levet din veamar lahem attem gevu li chovi ze eno nishmat shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 3)</small> "vaasher yihye lecha et achicha" veze bet din tovin oto. vechen bet din shechatchu et haddin vechatvu ish peloni atta chayyav litten laze kach vechach eno nishmat. shezze kegavuy hu ucheillu ba leyado veeno kemilve: 
Kesheraa hillel hazzaken shennimneu millehalvot ze et ze veovrin al hakkatuv battora <small>(Devarim 15 9)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar" vegomer hitkin perozbul kede shello yishshamet hachov ad sheyyalvu ze et ze. veen happerozbul moil ella bishmittat kesafim bazzeman hazze shehi middivre sofrim. aval shemitta shel tora en happerozbol moil bah: 
En kotvin perozbul ella chachamim gedolim beyoter kevet dino shel rabbi ammi verabbi assi shehen reuyin lehafekia mamon bene adam. aval shear batte dinin en kotvin: 
Zehu gufo shel perozbul. mosrani lachem peloni ufeloni haddayyanin shebbemakom peloni shekkol chov sheyyesh li sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze. vehaddayyanin o haedim chotmin millematta: 
En kotvin perozbul ella al hakkarka. im en karka lallove mocher lo hammalve kol shehu betoch sadehu afillu kelach shel keruv. hishilo makom letannur o lechira kotvin alav perozbul. hayta lo sade memushkenet kotvin aleha perozbul: 
Kotvin leish al nichse ishto velitomim al nichse appatroppus. en lo karka velaarev yesh lo karka kotvin aleha perozbul. haya lo chov al chavero veyesh lachavero karka hoil vehu tachat shibudo kotev alav perozbul: 
Echad shellava mechamishsha tzerichim perozbul lechol echad veechad. vachamishsha shellavu meechad dayyo perozbul echad lechullan: 
Katav happerozbul techilla veachar kach hilva eno moil. ella mashmit ad sheyyichtov happerozbul achar shehilva. nimtzeta omer shekkol milve hakkodemet lifrozbul enah nishmetet bifrozbul ze. veim happerozbul kodem lammilve nishmetet bifrozbul ze: 
Lefichach perozbul hammukdam kasher. vehameuchar pasul. ketzad. ketavo benisan vehikdim zemanno meadar kasher. shehare hura kocho sheeno mashmit ella ad adar. aval im icher zemanno uchetavo meiyyar pasul shehare meyappe kocho sheeno mashmit ad iyyar shello kaddin. sheen dino shello yashmit ella ad nisan bishat mesirat haddevarim levet din: 
Hammotzi shetar chov achar sheviit veen immo perozbul avad chovo. veim amar haya li veavad neeman. shemmizzeman hassakkana veelach baal chov gove shello bifrozbul. velo od ella kesheyyavi baal chov et shetaro o kesheyyavo litboa bemilve al pe omrim lannitba shallem lo. veim taan hannitba veamar ayye perozbul shello. omrim lattovea haya lecha perozbul veavad im amar hen neeman. veim hoda shello katav perozbul avad chovo. vehayetomim enan tzerichin perozbul: 
Hotzi perozbul vetaan hannitba veamar milve zo shehu tovea achar perozbul ze hayta vehattovea omer kodem perozbul hayta hattovea neeman. sheillu amar haya li veavad neeman veaf al pi sheen anu yodin zeman happerozbul sheavad: 
Taan hannitba veamar milve yesh lo etzli. vehattovea omer lo ki ella hakkafat chanut hi sheenah nishmetet shehare lo zakafti milve hare ze neeman. shehare im yirtze yomar milve hayta uferozbul haya li veavad. shekkevan shettikkenu chachamim perozbul chazaka hi sheen adam manniach davar muttar veochel davar asur: 
Talmide chachamim shehilvu ze et ze umasar devarav letalmidim veamar mosrani lachem shekkol chov sheyyesh li sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze eno tzarich lichtov perozbul. mippene shehen yodim shehashematat kesafim bazzeman hazze middivrehem uvidvarim bilvad hi nidchet: 
Kol hammachazir chov sheavra alav sheviit ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. vetzarich hammalve lomar lammachazir mashmit ani uchevar niftarta mimmenni. amar lo af al pi chen retzoni shettekabbel yekabbel mimmennu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 2)</small> "lo yiggsho" vahare lo nagas. veal yomar lo bechovi ani noten lecha ella yomar lo shelli hem uvemattana ani noten lecha: 
Hechezir lo chovo velo amar lo ken. mesabbev immo bidvarim ad sheyyomar lo shelli hem uvemattana netattim lecha. veim lo amar lo yekabbel mimmennu ella yittol meotav veyelech lo: 
Mi shennimna millehalvot et chavero kodem hashshemitta shemma yitacher hachov shello veyishshamet avar belo taase shenneemar hishshamer lecha vegomer. vechet gadol hu shehare hizhira alav tora bishne lavin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 9)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen" vegomer. vechol makom shenneemar hishshamer o pen o al hare ze mitzvat lo taase. vehattora hikpida al machashava raa zo ukeraattu <small>(Devarim 15 9)</small> "beliyyaal". vahare hosif hakkatuv lehazehir uletzauot shello yimmana ella yitten shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 10)</small> "naton titten lo velo yera levavcha betittecha lo" vegomer. vehivtiach hakkadosh baruch hu bischar mitzva zo baolam hazze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 10)</small> "ki biglal haddavar hazze yevarechcha" vegomer:

Mitzvat ase lispor sheva sheva shanim ulekaddesh shenat hachamishshim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 8)</small> "vesafarta lecha sheva shabbetot shanim" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 25 10)</small> "vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim". ushete mitzvot ellu mesurin levet din haggadol bilvad: 
Vmeematay hitchilu limnot. meachar arba esre shana mishshennichnesu laaretz shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 3)</small> "shesh shanim tizra sadecha veshesh shanim tizmor karmecha" [ad sheyyihye kol echad makkir et artzo. vesheva shanim asu] bechibbush haaretz vesheva shanim bechilluk. nimtzeta omer bishnat shalosh vachamesh meot vealpayim laytzira merosh hashshana meachar molad adam harishon shehi shana sheniyya laytzira hitchilu limnot. veasu shenat eser vachamesh meot laytzira shehi shenat achat veesrim mishshennichnesu laaretz shemitta. umanu sheva shemittot vekiddeshu shenat hachamishshim shehi shenat arba veshishshim mishshennichnesu laaretz: 
Shiva asar yovlim manu yisrael mishshennichnesu laaretz vead sheyyatzu. veshana sheyyatzu bah shecharav habbayit barishona motzae sheviit hayta ushenat shesh usheloshim bayyovel hayta. shearba meot shana veeser shanim amad bayit rishon. kevan shecharav habbayit batal minyan ze. mishshebbatla nishara haaretz chareva shivim shana venivna bayit sheni. vearba meot veesrim shana amad. uvashshana hashsheviit mibbinyano ala ezra vehi habbia hashsheniyya. umishshana zo hitchilu limnot minyan acher. veasu shenat 13 levinyan bayit sheni shemitta. umanu sheva shemittot vekiddeshu shenat hachamishshim. af al pi shello hayta sham yovel bevayit sheni monin hayu oto kede lekaddesh shemittot: 
Nimtzeta lamed shehashshana shecharav bah habbayit baacharona shettechillatah mittishre sheachar hachurban kishne chodashim shehare mittishre hu hamminyan lishmittim uleyovlot otah hashshana motzae sheviit hayta. ushenat 15 min hayyovel hatteshii hayta. ulefi cheshbon ze shana zo shehi shenat elef umea vesheva lachurban shehi shenat shemonim veshiva veelef vearba meot leminyan shetarot shehi shenat shesh usheloshim utesha meot vearbaat alafim laytzira hi shenat shemitta vehi shenat achat veesrim min hayyovel: 
Aval kol haggeonim amru shemmasoret hi bidehem ish mippi ish shello manu beotan hashshivim shana shebben churban bayit rishon uvinyan bayit sheni ella shemittot bilvad belo yovel. vechen mishshecharav baacharona lo manu shenat hachamishshim ella sheva sheva bilvad mittechillat shenat hachurban. vechen ole baggemara avoda zara cheshbon ze shehu kabbala: 
Ushenat hashshemitta yedua hi umefursemet etzel haggeonim veanshe eretz yisrael. vechullan lo manu ella lishne churban mashlichin otan sheva sheva. ulefi cheshbon ze tehi shana zo shehi shenat sheva umea veelef lachurban motzae sheviit. veal ze anu somchin. uchefi hacheshbon ze anu morin leinyan maasrot usheviit vehashematat kesafim shehakkabbala vehammaase ammudim gedolim behoraa uvahen rauy lehittalot: 
Shenat yovel enah ola mimminyan shene hashshavua. ella shenat tesha vearbaim shemitta ushenat chamishshim yovel. ushenat chamishshim veachat techillat shesh shanim shel shavua vechen bechol yovel veyovel: 
Mishsheggala shevet reuven veshevet gad vachatzi shevet menashshe batlu hayyovlot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 10)</small> "ukeratem deror baaretz lechol yshveha" bizman shekkol yoshveha aleha. vehu shello yihyu meurbavin shevet beshevet ella kullan yoshvin ketiknan. bizman shehayyovel [noheg baaretz] noheg bechutza laaretz shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 10 12)</small> "yovel hi" bechol makom ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit: 
Uvizman shehayyovel noheg noheg din eved ivri. vedin batte are choma. vedin sede charamim vedin sede achuzza. umekabbelin ger toshav venoheget sheviit baaretz vehashematat kesafim bechol makom min hattora. uvizman sheen hayyovel [noheg] eno noheg echad mikkol ellu chutz mishsheviit baaretz. vehashematat kesafim bechol makom middivrehem kemo shebbearnu: 
Mitzvat ase litkoa bashshofar baasiri letishre bishnat hayyovel. umitzva zo mesura levet din techilla (shenneemar 0 "vehaavarta shofar terua") vechol yachid veyachid chayyav litkoa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 9)</small> "taaviru shofar". vetokin bashshofar tesha kederech shettokin berosh hashshana. umaavirin shofar bechol gevul yisrael: 
Shofar shel yovel veshel rosh hashshana echad hu lechol davar. veechad rosh hashshana veechad hayyovel lattekiot. ella shebbayyovel tokin ben bevet din shekkiddeshu bo et hachodesh ben bevet din shello kiddeshu bo et hachodesh. vechol yachid veyachid chayyav litkoa kol zeman shebbet din yoshvin veshello bifne bet din: 
Uverosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat lo hayu tokin ella bevet din shekkiddeshu bo et hachodesh. veen kol yachid veyachid tokea ella bifne bet din: 
Shelosha devarim meakkevin bayyovel. tekia veshilluach avadim vehachezarat sadot levaalehen. vezo hi shemittat karka: 
Merosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim lo hayu avadim niftarim levattehen velo mishtabedin laadonehen. velo hassadot chozrot levaalehen. ella avadim ochlin veshotim usemechim veatrotehem berashehem. kevan shehiggia yom hakkippurim taku bet din bashshofar nifteru avadim levattehen vechazru sadot levaalehen: 
Din hayyovel bishvitat haaretz vedin hashshemitta echad hu lechol davar. kol sheasur bashsheviit meavodat haaretz asur bishnat yovel. vechol shemmuttar bashsheviit muttar bayyovel. umelachot shellokin alehen bashsheviit lokin alehen bayyovel. vedin perot shenat yovel baachila uvammechira uvabbiur kedin perot sheviit lechol davar: 
Yetera sheviit al hayyovel shehashsheviit meshammetet kesafim velo yovel. veyoter yovel al hashsheviit shehayyovel motzi avadim umashmit karka. vezehu din mechirat sadot haamurot battora vehi mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 24)</small> "geulla tittenu laaretz". yovel meshammet karka bitchillato usheviit enah meshammetet kesafim ella besofah kemo shebbearnu:

Eretz yisrael hammitchalleket lishvatim enah nomkeret litzmitut shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 23)</small> "vehaaretz lo timmacher litzmitut". veim machar litzmitut shenehem ovrin belo taase. veen maasehen moilin ella tachazor hassade livaleha bayyovel: 
Vehammocher sadehu leshishshim shana enah yotza bayyovel sheen chozer bayyovel ella davar hanimkar setam o hanimkar litzmitut: 
Lo yimkor adam beto o sede achuzzato af al pi shehem chozrin achar zeman ella im ken heeni shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 25)</small> "vechi yamuch achicha umachar meachuzzato". aval limkor ulehanniach haddamim bechiso o laasot bahen sechora o likkach bahen kelim o avadim uvehema eno rashshay ella limzonot bilvad. veim avar umachar mikkol makom hare ellu mechurin: 
Vedanin bevayit din batte are choma uvesade din sede achuzza. din mocher sede achuzzato lechashshev et haddamim lefi hashshanim hannisharot layyovel. uvechol et sheyyirtze lifdot mechashshev im hallokeach al hashshanim sheachal. vegorea middeme hammocher umachazir lo hashshear: 
Ketzad. hare hannishar layyovel eser shanim umachar lo sade bemea dinar. achalah hallokeach shalosh shanim veratza hammocher ligl noten lo shivim dinar umachazir sadehu. vechen im achalah shesh shanim noten lo arbaim dinar umachazir lo sadehu. lo gealah ella hinnichah beyad hallokeach ad shenat hayyovel tachazor labbealim belo damim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach": 
Mecharah lo vehi melea perot uleachar shete shanim gealah eno yachol lomar lo hachazirenna li melea perot kemo shemmacharti lecha. lefichach im mecharah lo melea perot lifne rosh hashshana ugealah achar shete shanim hare ze ochel shalosh tevuot bishte hashshanim veeno mechashshev immo ella lefi shete shanim bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 18)</small> "al pi hashshanim" lo al pi hattevuot: 
Hakkanim vehazzemorot uferot shikma shebbetochah hare hen shel lokeach kishar happerot shellah. aval ilan shennichsach o sheyyavash shenehen asurin bo. ketzad yaase. yimmacher veyillakach bedamav karka vehallokeach ochel peroteha ad shettiggael hassade miyyado: 
Hallokeach sede achuzza unetaah ilanot vehishbicha keshehi chozeret bayyovel shamin shevach hailanot shebbetochah. venoten baal hassade deme hashshevach lallokeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 33)</small> "veyatza mimkar bayit" mimkar chozer velo hashshevach: 
Hammocher et sadehu bizman shehayyovel noheg kemo shebbearnu eno muttar ligl lefachot mishshete shanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach". vaafillu ratza hallokeach asur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "bemispar shanim achar hayyovel tikne meet amitecha". en pachot mishshete shanim meet leet miyyom hammechira: 
Vetzarich sheyyochal hallokeach shete tevuot bishte shanim veachar kach yigal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "shene tevuot". lefichach im hayta achat mishshete hashshanim sheviit o shenat shiddafon o yerakon enah ola min hamminyan: 
Hinnichah hallokeach bura shana vaachalah shana. o achalah shana venarah shana velo zeraah hare ellu olin lamminyan. mecharah bishnat yovel atzmah enah nimkeret vehaddamim chozrin labbealim: 
Mecharah shana achat lifne hayyovel hare hallokeach ochel otah shana sheniyya achar hayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "shene tevuot": 
Machar nekaim meleim mayim o selaim sheenam reuyin lizria hare ze pode befachot mishshete shanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 15)</small> "bemispar shene tevuot". sade harauy lattevua hi sheenah nigelet ella achar shete shanim. veim lo gealah af al pi sheenah reuya lizria chozeret labbealim bayyovel: 
Machar ilanot en nigalin lefachot mishshete shanim shehare reuyim litvuot. veim lo gealan enan chozrin labbealim bayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 27 28)</small> "veshav laachuzzato" velo lailanot: 
Machar sadehu lerishon verishon machar lesheni vesheni lishlishi afillu mea ze achar ze bishnat hayyovel tachazor laadon harishon. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 24)</small> "bishnat hayyovel yashuv hassade laasher kanahu meitto laasher lo achuzzat haaretz": 
Mecharah lerishon bemea dinar verishon lesheni bematayim veratza haadon ligl eno mechashshev ella im harishon shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 27)</small> "laish asher machar lo". mecharah lerishon bematayim verishon lesheni bemea hare ze mechashshev im haacharon. vechen im machar bemea vehishbicha beyad hallokeach vahare hi reuya lehimmacher bematayim mechashshev lefi ma shemmachar. veim mecharah bematayim vehichsifa vahare hi reuya lehimmacher bemea mechashshev lefi ma shehi. uleolam meyappim koach mocher sede achuzza umerein koach hallokeach: 
Hammocher sede achuzzato vehayu lo sadot acherot umachar meotam hassadot kede ligl sade shemmachar en shomin lo. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 26)</small> "umatza kede geullato" ad sheyyimtza davar sheeno matzuy lo beshaa shemmachar. vechen im lava ligl en shomin lo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 26)</small> "vehissiga yado" lo sheyyilve: 
Matza meat veratza ligl chatzi hassade shemmachar en shomin lo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 26)</small> "kede geullato". o goel et kullah o eno goel. veim ratzu kerovav ligl goalim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 25)</small> "uva goalo hakkarov elav": 
Hannoten sadehu mattana hare zo chozeret lo bayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 13)</small> "tashuvu ish el achuzzato" lerabbot et hammattana: 
Haachin shechalku kelakochot hen umachzirin ze laze chelko bayyovel. lo tibbatel chalukatan mikkemot shehayta. vechen habbechor vehameyabbem eshet achiv machazir bayyovel chelek shennatal venotel hachelek shekkenegdo: 
Aval hayyoresh et ishto af al pi sheyyerushshat habbaal middivrehem asu chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora veeno machazir bayyovel. veim yarash mimmenna bet hakkevarot yachazir livne mishpacha mishshum pegam mishpacha veyittenu lo dameha umenakkin lo deme kever ishto shehare chayyav bikvuratah:

Hammocher bayit betoch ir hammekkefet choma hare ze goalah kol 12 chodesh miyyom shemmachar bechol et sheyyirtze. vaafillu bayyom shemmachar. uchesherotze lifdot noten kol haddamim shellakach veeno gorea lallokeach kelum: 
Veen hakkerovim podin otah ella hammocher atzmo im hissiga yado. veyesh lo limkor minnechasav velifdoto. aval lo yalve veyigal. velo yigal lachatzain: 
Met hallokeach yifde miyyad beno. vechen im met hammocher yesh livno lifdotah kol 12 chodesh: 
Machar larishon verishon lashsheni betoch hashshana monin larishon. kevan sheshshalma shana rishona huchlat habbayit beyad hashsheni. shehammocher machar lashsheni kol zechut shettavo leyado. higgia 12 chodesh velo gealah hare zo nechletet beyad hallokeach. vechen im natan habbayit mattana velo gealo kol 12 chodesh hare ze nechlat beyad ze shennatan lo mattana: 
Hayta shana meubberet eno nechlat ad sofah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 30)</small> "ad melot lo shana temima" lehavi chodesh haibbur: 
Machar shene battim echad bachatzi adar rishon veechad berosh adar sheni. ze shemmachar berosh adar sheni kevan shehiggia echad baadar shel shana habbaa alta lo shana. veze shemmachar bachatzi adar rishon lo alta lo shana ad chatzi adar shel shana habbaa mippene sheyyarad hallokeach bechodesh haibbur: 
Higgia yom 12 chodesh velo nimtza hallokeach lifdot mimmennu hare ze manniach meotav bevet din veshover et haddelet venichnas leveto. veematay sheyyavo hallokeach yavo veyittol meotav: 
Hammakdish bet ir choma ugealo acher miyyad hahekdesh kevan shealta lo shana mishshaa shennigal miyyad hahekdesh velo gealo bealav nechlat beyad haggoel. sheen hahekdesh cholet ella hallokeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 30)</small> "lakkone oto ledorotav": 
Machar bet ir choma vehiggia yovel betoch shenat hammecher eno chozer beyovel. ella yihye beyad hallokeach ad sheyyirtze hammocher ligl kol shenat hammecher o timmale shana veyachlot: 
Hammocher bayit bevatte chatzerim o beir sheenah mukkefet choma karauy hare ze nigal bechoach yafe shebbedin hassade veshebbedin habbattim hammukkafin choma. ketzad. im ratza ligl miyyad goel kedin habbattim. higgia 12 chodesh velo gaal hare ze goel ad shenat hayyovel kedin hassadot. uveet sheggoel mechashshev im hammocher vegorea lo ma sheachal. higgia yovel velo gaal chozer habbayit belo damim kedin hassadot: 
Kol shehu lefanim min hachoma kegon hagginnot vehammerchatzaot vehashshovachot hare hu kevattim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 30)</small> "asher bair". aval hassadot shebbetoch hair nigalin kedin hassadot shechutz lair shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 30)</small> "vekam habbayit asher bair". bayit vechol haddome levayit lo hassadot: 
Bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot eno nechlat kevate are choma. virushalayim en habbayit nechlat bah. uvayit habbanuy bachoma eno kevatte are choma: 
Ir sheggaggoteha chomatah o shehayyam chomatah enah kemukkefet choma: 
En hammakom nikra are choma ad sheyyihye bo shalosh chatzerot o yeter uvechol chatzer mehen shene battim o yeter veyakkifuha choma techilla veachar kach yivnu hachatzerot betocho. aval makom sheyyashav veachar kach hukkaf o shello hayu bo shalosh chatzerot shel shene battim eno <small>(Vayikra 25 29)</small> "ir choma" ella battim shebbo kevatte hachatzerim: 
En somchin ella al choma hammukkefet bishat kibbush haaretz. ketzad. ir shello hayta mukkefet choma beshaa shekkavash yehoshua et haaretz af al pi shemmukkefet atta hare hi kevatte hachatzerim. veir shehayta mukkefet choma bime yehoshua af al pi sheenah mukkefet atta hare hi kemukkefet. vechevan sheggalu bechurban rishon batla kedushshat are choma shehayu bime yehoshua. kevan sheala ezra babbia hashsheniyya nitkaddeshu kol hearim hammukkafot choma beoto haet mippene shebbiatan bime ezra shehi bia sheniyya keviatan bime yehoshua. ma biatan bime yehoshua manu shemittin veyovlot vekiddeshu batte are choma venitchayyevu bemaaser. af biatam bime ezra manu shemittin veyovlot vekiddeshu batte are choma venitchayyevu bemaaser: 
Vechen leatid lavo bevia shelishit beet sheyyikkansu laaretz yatchilu limnot shemittin veyovlot vikaddeshu batte are choma veyitchayyev kol makom sheyyichbeshuhu bemaasrot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 30 5)</small> "veheviacha Adonai elohecha el haaretz asher yarshu avotecha virishtah". makkish yerushshatcha lirushshat avotecha. ma yerushshat avotecha atta noheg [bah] bechiddush kol haddevarim haellu af yerushshatcha atta noheg bah bechiddush kol haddevarim haellu:

Shevet levi af al pi sheen lahem chelek baaretz kevar nitztauu yisrael litten lahem arim lashevet umigreshehem. vehearim hem shesh are miklat vaalehen shetayim vearbaim ir. ucheshemmosifin are miklat acherot bime hammashiach hakkol lalviyyim:

Migreshe hearim kevar nitparshu battora shehem sheloshet alafim amma lechol ruach mikkir hair vechutza shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 4)</small> "mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv". ulehallan hu omer <small>(Bamidbar la 5)</small> "umaddotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma" vegomer. elef harishonim migrash vealpayim shemmoddin chutz lammigrash lesadot ucheramim:

Venotnin lechol ir bet hakkevarot chutz litchum ze. sheen kovrin metehem litchum arehem shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 3)</small> "umigreshehem yihyu livhemtam velirchusham ulechol chayyatam" lechayyim nittenu velo likvura:
En osin beare haleviyyim ir migrash velo migrash ir velo migrash sade velo sade migrash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 34)</small> "usede migrash arehem lo yimmacher":

Vmippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 34)</small> "lo yimmacher" lo yeshune ella hassade vehammigrash vehair kol echad mishshelashtan kemot shehu leolam. vechen bishar are yisrael:
Lo yistor adam et beto laasoto ginna velo yitta churbato ginna shello yacharivu eretz yisrael:

Kohanim uleviyyim shemmachru sade missede arehem o bayit mibbatte are choma shellahen en goalin kasseder hazze. ella mochrin hassadot vaafillu samuch layyovel vegoalin miyyad. veim hikdishu sade goalim miyyad hahekdesh leachar hayyovel. vegoalim batte are choma kol zeman sheyyirtzu afillu achar kamma shanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 32)</small> "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim":
Yisrael sheyyarash et avi immo levi hare ze goel kilviyyim af al pi sheeno levi hoil vehearim o hassadot shel leviyyim goel leolam. sheddin ze taluy bimkomot ellu velo babbealim:
Velevi sheyyarash et avi immo yisrael goel keyisrael velo kilviyyim shello neemar <small>(Vayikra 25 32)</small> "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim" ella beare haleviyyim:

Kol shevet levi muzharin shello yinchalu beeretz kenaan. vechen hen muzharin shello yittelu chelek babbizzah beshaa shekkovshin et hearim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 1)</small> "lo yihye lakkohanim haleviyyim kol shevet levi chelek venachala im yisrael". chelek babbizza venachala baaretz. vechen hu omer <small>(Bamidbar 18 20)</small> "beartzam lo tinchal vechelek lo yihye lecha betocham" babbizza. uven levi o kohen shennatal chelek babbizza loke. veim natal nachala baaretz maavirin otah mimmennu:

Yerae li sheen haddevarim amurim ella baaretz shennichreta aleha berit leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov virashuha benehem venitchalleka lahem. aval shear kol haaratzot shekkovesh melech mimmalche yisrael hare hakkohanim vehaleviyyim beotan haaratzot uvevizzatan kechol yisrael:

Velamma lo zacha levi benachalat eretz yisrael uvevizzatah im echav mippene shehuvdal laavod et Adonai lesharto ulehorot derachav hayesharim umishpatav hatztzaddikim larabbim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 33 10)</small> "yoru mishpatecha leyaakov vetoratcha leyisrael". lefichach huvdelu middarche haolam lo orchin milchama kishar yisrael velo nochalin velo zochin leatzman bechoach gufan. ella hem chel hashshem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 33 11)</small> "barech Adonai chelo". vehu baruch hu zoche lahem shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 20)</small> "ani chelkecha venachalatcha":

Velo shevet levi bilvad ella kol ish veish mikkol bae haolam asher nadva rucho oto vehevino maddao lehibbadel laamod lifne Adonai lesharto uleavdo ledea et Adonai vehalach yashar kemo sheasahu haelohim ufarak meal tzavvaro ol hacheshbonot harabbim asher bikkeshu bene haadam hare ze nitkaddesh kodesh kadashim veyihye Adonai chelko venachalato leolam uleolme olamim veyizke lo baolam hazze davar hammaspik lo kemo shezzacha lakkohanim lalviyyim. hare david alav hashshalom omer <small>(Tehillim 16 5)</small> "Adonai menat chelki vechosi atta tomich gorali":
Mishneh Torah, Sacrifices Rendered Unfit:
Kol happesulin laavoda muttarin lishchot kadashim lechattechilla vaafillu kadshe kadashim. chutz min hattame sheeno shochet lechattechilla. veaf al pi shehu chutz laazara ufashat yadav veshachat baazara gezera shemma yigga babbasar:
Veim avar veshachat hazzevach kasher. vechen par kohen gadol shel yom hakkippurim af al pi shenneemar bo <small>(Vayikra 16 11)</small> "veshachat aharon" im shechato zar kasher. af para adumma sheshshachat hazzar keshera sheen lecha shechita pesula bezar:
Hashshochet et hakkadashim velo nitkavven lishchita ella kemitassek. hare ellu pesulin ad sheyyitkavven lishchita:
Velo yishchot shene rashim keechad bekadashim veim shachat hare ellu kesherim:
Aval shenayim shochatin behema achat bekadashim kechullin:
Hakkatan eno shochet kadashim af al pi shehaggadol omed al gabbav. shehakkadashim tzerichin machashava vekatan en lo machashava. afillu hayta machshavto nikkeret mittoch maasav enah machashava lehakel ella lehachemir. ketzad. hayta ola omedet baddarom umeshachah hakkatan veheviah latztzafon ushechatah shehare mimmaasav nikkar shemmachshavto lishchitat kadashim hare zo pesula:
Kadshe kadashim shennishchatu baddarom o shennitkabbel damam baddarom pesulin:
Haya omed baddarom vehoshit yado latztzafon veshachat shechitato keshera:
Haya omed baddarom vehoshit yado vekibbel haddam batztzafon. kabbalato pesula:
Hichnis rosho verubbo latztzafon hare hu keomed batztzafon:
Shechatah batztzafon ufirkesa veyatzat laddarom. afillu hotziah laddarom keshera. pirkesa veyatzat laddarom vechazra latztzafon veachar kach kibbel damah batztzafon keshera. vechen kadashim kallim shehayu bifnim veamad chutz laazara vehichnis yado lefanim veshachat shechitato keshera:
Hichnis yado vekibbel kabbalato pesula afillu hichnis rosho verubbo. afillu haya haoved kullo bifnim vetzitzato bachutz avodato pesula. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 9)</small> "bevoachem el ohel moed" ad sheyyavou kullan:
Pirkesa habbehema veyatzat lachutz achar kabbalat damah keshera. sheafillu yatzu haemurin vehabbasar kodem zerika bekadashim kallim hazzevach kasher kemo sheyyitbaer:
Hayta habbehema kullah bifnim veragleha bachutz ushechatah hazzevach pasul. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 5)</small> "vehevium laAdonai" ad shettihye kullah bifnim:
Shechatah vehi kullah bifnim. veachar kach hotzia raglah lachutz. chotech habbasar ad shehu maggia laetzem veachar kach mekabbel haddam. veim kibbel veachar kach chatach pasul mippene shamnunit habbasar shebbachutz. uvekadashim kallim en tzarich lachtoch ella machzir raglah lefanim umekabbel. shebbesar kadashim [kallim] sheyyatza kodem zerika kasher:
Tala habbehema ushechatah baavir haazara pesula. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 11)</small> "al yerech hammizbeach" ad sheyyishchot baaretz:
Hayta habbehema baaretz venitla veshachat vehu taluy baavir. bekadshe kadashim pasul. bekadashim kallim kasher:
Shachat miut simanim bachutz ugemaran bifnim. o sheshshachat miutan baddarom ugemaran batztzafon pesulin. sheyyeshna lashshechita mittechillatah vead sof:
Nitla vekibbel haddam mitztzavvar behema hammunnachat bakkarka pasul. sheen derech sherut bechach:
Haya omed baazara vetala hammizrak beyado vekibbel haddam baavir. o shehigbiah habbehema vekibbel haddam baavir kasher. sheavir hammakom kammakom:
Natan mizrak letoch mizrak vekibbel kasher. min bemino eno chotzetz. hinniach siv betoch hammizrak vekibbel kasher. mippene shehassiv chalul vahare haddam yored letoch hammizrak veen kan chatzitza. aval im asa ken bikmitzat hammincha vekamatz mittoch hassiv pesula:
Kabbalat haddam veholachato lammizbeach uzerikato vechen holachat evarim lakkevesh kol achat meellu enah keshera ella bechohen hakkasher laavoda kemo shebbearnu bikmitzat hammincha uvimlikat haof:
Veholacha shello baregel enah holacha. lefichach kohen gadol shekkibbel et haddam veamad bimkomo uzerako lammizbeach nifsal hazzevach:
Kibbel bimino venatan lismolo yachzir limino. kibbel bichli chol nifsal hazzevach. kibbel bichli kodesh venatan lichli chol yachzir lichli kodesh:
Nishpach min hakkeli al haritzpa vaasafo kasher. aval im nishpach mitztzavvar habbehema al haritzpa vaasafo unetano lichli hashsharet nifsal hazzevach:
Nishpach miktzat haddam mitztzavvar behema al haaretz velo asafo vekibbel miktzato mitztzavvar behema. hare ze kasher uvilvad sheyyihye ze haddam shennitkabbel dam hannefesh. lo dam hattamtzit velo dam haor:
Kol hazzevachim shekkibbel damam echad min happesulin laavoda. o sheholich et haddam lammizbeach. o shezzerako lammizbeach kehilchato. nifsal hazzevach. kibbel hakkasher venatan lefasul velo hillech bo happasul ella amad bimkomo yachzir lakkasher. aval dam sheholicho happasul laavoda vehecheziro lakkasher veholicho. o sheholicho hakkohen techilla vehecheziro unetano lappasul veholicho. hoil veholicho happasul ben battechilla ben bassof nifsal hazzevach. shehare i efshar letakken davar ze:
Kibbel happasul. im nishar dam hannefesh chozer hakkasher umekabbel umolich vezorek. sheen happesulin laavoda osin haddam hannishar sheyarim. chutz min hattame hoil vehu rauy laavoda bekarban habba betuma kemo shebbearnu. ose sheyarim ketzad. kibbel hattame. af al pi shekkibbel acharav hakkasher dam hannefesh uzerako nifsal hazzevach. shezze shekkibbel hakkasher baacharona sheyarim hu veeno kelum:
Behema shechasar meevareha kol shehu achar shechita kodem kabbalat haddam nifsela. afillu tzaram beaznah kodem kabbala hare ze lo yekabbel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 14)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 18)</small> "velakach middam happar" sheyyihye shalem kullo bishat hakkabbala. veim kibbel min hachasera vezarak hare ze pasul: 
Aval im chasra achar kabbala kodem zerika. afillu avad habbasar kodem zerikat haddam o nisraf. im nishtayyer kezayit min habbasar o kezayit min haemurin zorek et haddam. veim lav eno zorek. uveola afillu kachatzi zayit min habbasar vachatzi zayit min haemurin. mippene shekkullah laishshim:
Nishar pachot mikkezayit lo yizrok. veim zarak lo hurtza. nifsal habbasar kodem zerika o sheyyatza chutz laazara lo yizrok haddam. veim zarak hurtza:
Besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza chutz laazara kodem zerikat damim. af al pi shennizrak haddam vehabbasar bachutz hazzevach kasher mippene shessof habbasar latzet. vehazzerika moelet layyotze lesarfo aval lo leachlo:
Vechen emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim venizrak haddam vehem bachutz lo nifsal hazzevach. veim hechziran maktirin otan. veaf al pi shello hechziran chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame:
Kol hazzevachim shel yachid. ben shennitma basar vehachelev kayyam ben shennitma chelev vehabbasar kayyam. zorek et haddam. nitmeu shenehen lo yizrok. veim zarak hurtza. shehatztzitz meratztze al hattuma. vechen emurin o evre ola shennitmeu vehiktiran hatztzitz meratztze kemo shebbearnu. vechol karbenot hatztzibbur shennitma habbasar vehachelev kullo hare ze zorek et haddam:
Dam kadashim sheyyatza chutz laazara nifsal hazzevach. veaf al pi shechazar vehichniso uzerako al hammizbeach lo nirtza:
Vechol dam hakkadashim eno mekabbel tuma kelal shenneemar baddam <small>(Devarim 12 16)</small> <small>(Devarim 12 24)</small> "al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim". dam shennishpach kemayim hu hannechshav kemayim umekabbel tuma aval dam kadashim sheeno nishpach kemayim eno mekabbel tuma: 
Vedam sheshshaka alav chamma velo nizrak nifsal hazzevach. veim zerako lo hurtza:

Kol haddamim hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon. im natan mattana achat bilvad kipper. vaafillu bechattat mattana achat hi haikkar ushear haarba mattanot lemitzva. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 27)</small> "vedam zevachecha yishshafech al mizbach Adonai elohecha". shefichat haddam al hammizbeach hi haikkar:
Vechol hannittanin bizrika shennetanan bishficha yatza. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 27)</small> "vedam zevachecha yishshafech":

Kol haddamim hannittanin al mizbeach happenimi. im chisser achat mehen lo kipper. ella kullan hen ikkar hakkappara. shehare hakkatuv hikpid al minyanan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 6)</small> <small>(Vayikra 4 17)</small> "sheva peamim":
Chattat shennatan mimmennu mattana achat umetu habbealim. yashlim arba mattanot leachar hammita:
Aval im natan haachat bayyom lo yitten hashshalosh ballayla:
Veim natan achat bifnim vehishliman bachutz chayyav mishshum maale bachutz:
Haya mazze veniktea yado shel mazze kodem sheyyaggia dam laavir hammizbeach. lo alta lo hazzaya:
Shinna mattan karbanot bechattat. ben bechattat hannaaset bifnim ben bechattat hannaaset bachutz nifsal. aval bishar kadashim kesherin:
Natan haddam min hakkeren velifnim. ben bechattat ben bishar kadashim. ben bammizbeach happenimi ben bammizbeach hachitzon. pasul:

Dam shemmitzvato litten oto lemala mechatzi hammizbeach shennetano lematta. o shemmitzvato litteno lematta unetano lemala. o shemmitzvato litteno bifnim bahechol unetano al mizbeach hachitzon. o hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan lifnim bahechol. o shennatan dam hannittanin bachutz al hakkevesh shello keneged hayesod. hare besar hazzevach pasul. veaf al pi chen nitkapperu habbealim bo kevan shehiggia dam lammizbeach. af al pi shehiggia shello limkomo hare hu kemo shehiggia limkomo lechapper. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya ze hazzorek kasher laavoda. aval im kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul venatan happasul et hannittanin lemala lematta. veet hannittanin bifnim bachutz. veet hannittanin bachutz bifnim. o shennatan al hakkevesh shello keneged hayesod. lo nifsal besar hazzevach im nishar dam hannefesh. ella yachzor hakkasher vikabbel shear dam hannefesh veyizrok haddam bimkomo:

Deme kadashim shennitarvu. ben dam bedam. ben kosot bechosot. im nitarvu hannittanin mattana achat bannittanin mattana achat. yitten hakkol mattana achat. vechen hannittanin mattan arba bannittanin mattan arba. yitten hakkol mattan arba. nitarvu hannittanin mattana achat bannittanin mattan shetayim shehen arba. yitten hakkol mattana achat. nitarvu hannittanin lemala bannittanin lematta. yishshafech hakkol laamma vehazzevachim pesulin. afillu nitarvu sheyare hachattat im dam haola shemmekom hakkol lematta yishshafech hakkol laamma:
Veim lo shaal ella natan min hattaarovot lemala ulematta hare ze kasher. natan lemala veshaal yitten lematta veellu veellu alu lo:

Nitarvu hannittanin bifnim bannittanin bachutz. yishpoch hakkol laamma. veim lo shaal velakach dam hattaarovet venatan mimmennu bifnim uvachutz. ben shennatan bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz o bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim hakkol kasher. bamme devarim amurim bishar damim hannittanim bachutz chutz min hachattat. aval dam chattat hannaaset bachutz shennitarev bedam chattat hannaaset bifnim. im natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim kasher. natan bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz pesula. sheddam chattat shennichnas lahechol afillu chattat yachid hanneechelet asura. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 23)</small> "vechol chattat asher yuva middamah" vegomer. vehu sheyyavo derech shaar hahechol. shenneemar yuva derech bia. aval im hichniso befishpash o derech challon o gag. eno nifsal:

Par helem vesair avoda zara sheddamam nichnas lahechol. im hichniso lekodesh hakkadashim nifsal shebbemakom ze penima shel mekoman hu. vechen par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheddamam nichnas lekodesh hakkadashim im hichnis damam lekodesh hakkadashim vehizza mimmennu vehotzio lahechol vechazar vehichniso lekodesh hakkadashim nifsal veeno gomer mimmennu hazzayot shebbekodesh hakkadashim kevan sheyyatza yatza. vechen im gamar hazzayot shebbekodesh hakkadashim vehotzian lahechol. vehizza miktzat hazzayot vehotzian chutz lahechol vechazar vehichnisan lahechol. eno gomer hazzayot shebbahechol. shekkevan sheyyatza haddam chutz limkomo nifsal:

Chattat shekkibbel damah bishne kosot veyatza echad mehem lachutz. happenimi kasher veyazze mimmennu. nichnas echad mehem lahechol vehizza mimmennu sham. af hachitzon pasul. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 23)</small> "asher yuva middamah" afillu miktzat damah im nichnas lechapper bakkodesh nifsela:

Dam chattat shehichniso lechapper bo bifnim. velo kipper ella hotzio velo hizza mimmennu bifnim kelum. im hichniso beshogeg hare ze kasher umazze mimmennu bachutz shehare lo kipper bakkodesh. veim hichniso bemezid pasul:
Hichnis hachattat atzmah lahechol keshera shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 23)</small> "asher yuva middamah" velo besarah:
Chattat haof sheppirkesa venichnesa lahechol keshera:
Hichnis dam chattat haof lahechol betzavvarah hare ze safek im hatztzavvar chashuv kichli:
Nishpach dam chattat haof vaasafo. hare ze safek im hakkeli posel bedamah o eno posel. lefichach tissaref kechol chattat haof shehu safek:

Chattat shekkibbel damah bearbaa kosot. venatan mattana achat mikkol kos vechos. sheyare arbatan nishpach al hayesod shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 30)</small> <small>(Vayikra 4 34)</small> "veet kol damah yishpoch". natan arba hammattanot mikkos echad. sheyare oto hakkos nishpach al hayesod ushear hakkosot nishpachin laamma:

Dam shennafal letoch hammayim o letoch dame chullin lo yazze mimmennu veim hizza pasul. nafal mayim letoch haddam shebbammizrak. im yesh bo mare dam kasher. nafal letocho yayin o dam chullin. omdin oto illu hayu mayim. im reuyin levattel dam shebbammizrak ad shello yihyu marav mare dam hare ze lo yazze mimmennu. veim enam reuyin levattel marav yazze mimmennu:

Dam hakkadashim shennitarev bedam pesule hammizbeach o bedam hakkadashim shennifselu bishchita. yishshafech hakkol laamma. vaafillu karvu kol hakkosot chutz meechad yishshafech laamma vechol otan hazzevachim pesulim. nitarev bedam hattamtzit yishshafech laamma. veim lo shaal venatan kasher:

Haemurin veevre haolot vehakkematzim vehallevona umenachot hannisrafot achar shennitkaddeshu bichli sharet. im zarak echad mikkol ellu al gabbe haishshim ben beyad ben bichli ben beyamin ben bismol hare ellu kesherim:
Hayyayin vehammayim shennischan ben bikara ben behin ben bishar kele hashsharet kesherim. nissechan bichli chol o beyado pesulin:

Evarim shessidderan vechen kometz shessiddero vesidder haetzim shel maaracha lemala mehem. o shessidderan mitztzidde haetzim. hare ze safek im derech haketara bechach o en derech haketara bechach. lefichach lo yaase chen lechattechilla veim asa hurtza:

Kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan berosh hammizbeach keillu shechatan batztzafon shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 21)</small> "vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha". melammed shekkol hammizbeach rauy lishchitat haola ushechitat hashshelamim:

Ola sheshshechatah berosh hammizbeach. o sheshshechatah lematta veheela otah lerosh hammizbeach. yafshit otah vinattechenna bimkomah. umorid hakkeravayim umedichan lematta. vechozer umaale otan umorid haor venotno lakkohanim:

Vechen zevachim shechutim shealu legabbe hammizbeach. mafshitan umenattechan bimkoman umorid hakkeravayim umedichan bemayim vechozer umaale otan umorid et haor veet habbasar venotno labbealim vechozer umaktir et hashshear. umippene ma lo yorid hakkol ella yafshit vinatteach berosh hammizbeach. shekkol harauy laishshim im ala lerosh hammizbeach lo yered. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 37)</small> "kol hannogea bammizbeach yikdash". yachol af al pi sheeno rauy. talmud lomar <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "hi haola al mokda". ma ola shehi reuya laishshim im alta lo tered af kol harauy laishshim im ala lo yered:
Ola sheheelah chayya lerosh hammizbeach tered sheadayin enah reuya:
Vechen kometz hammincha shello nitkaddesh bichli sharet. vechol issure hammizbeach shealu yerdu lefi sheenan reuyin mittechillatan:
Vechen behemat kadashim shennishchata ballayla o nishpach damah o sheyyatzat chutz laazara im alta tered:

Aval kadashim shellanu o shellan haddam o habbasar o haemurim. vezevach sheyyatza chutz laazara. o shennitma o nifsal bemachshevet hazzeman o bemachshevet makom o bemachshevet shinnuy. o shekkibbelu hattemeim vezarku et damo hoil ureuyin baavodat karban habba betuma. veshennatan damo chutz limkomo o kadshe kadashim shennishchatu baddarom o shennitkabbel damam baddarom. af al pi shekkol ellu pesulim im alu lerosh hammizbeach lo yerdu:
Kol sheppissulo bakkodesh hakkodesh mekabbelo. ucheshem sheim alu lo yerdu kach im yardu lo yaalu sheniyya shehare pesulin hem:
Veim mashla bahem haur af al pi sheyyardu yaalu sheniyya veyashlim haketaratan:
Kometz shennitpaggel umiktzato baaretz umiktzato mashla bo haur yaale kullo:
Evarim vachalavim ukematzim shellanu berosho shel mizbeach keillu lanu baazara veim yardu lo yaalu. aval im lo yardu maktirin otan leolam:
Vaavir mizbeach kemizbeach. veemure kadashim kallim sheheelan kodem zerikat damim lo yerdu. shehare naasa lachmo shel mizbeach:
Hifrish shene ashamot leacharayut veshachat et shenehem vekadam veheela emurim shel echad mehem kodem zerika hare ellu yerdu:

Hazzevach happasul vehannesachim happesulim shealu lammizbeach. hazzevach lo yered kemo shebbearnu mippene shehu rauy laishshim. vehannesachim yerdu. vechen nesachim habbaim bifne atzman shennifselu vealu yerdu:
Of shemmelako zar veala lo yered. vekometz hammincha shekkematzo veala yered. af al pi shezze pasul veze pasul ze keillu lo nitkaddesh kelal. veechad hazzar veechad shear happesulim:

Veellu im yaalu yerdu. kol sheeno rauy laishshim. besar kadshe kadashim uvesar kadashim kallim. motar haomer usheyare menachot ushete hallechem velechem happanim vehakketoret. vetzemer shebberashe kevasim vesear shebbizkan hatteyashim vehaatzamot vehaggidim. vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim bizman sheenan mechubbarim im alu yerdu:
Kometz shemmitztza shamno al haetzem veyarad haetzem yachaziro. shehaddavar safek shemma chibbure olin keolin hem chashuvin:

Mizbeach happenimi mekaddesh pesulim ben reuyin lo ben sheenan reuyin lo. aval mizbeach hachitzon eno mekaddesh ella pesulin haruyin lo kemo shebbearnu. ketzad. mizbeach hachitzon shealu lo zevachim shennifselu lo yerdu. alta lo ketoret zara tered sheen hakketoret zara reuya lammizbeach hachitzon. aval mizbeach happenimi sheala lo kometz mincha ben kasher ben pasul lo yered. vechen kol kayyotze baze. keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo kach hakkevesh ushear kele hashsharet mekaddeshin et harauy lahem shehare neemar bakkelim <small>(Shemot 30 29)</small> "kol hannogea bahem yikdash". mishsheyyaggia lakkevesh davar harauy lo lo yered veaf al pi shennifsal. vechen kesheyyaggia lichli sharet kol davar harauy lo mitkaddesh velo yippade leolam veaf al pi shennifsal kemo shebbearnu beissure hammizbeach:

En kele hallach mekaddeshot et hayyavesh. velo kele hayyavesh mekaddeshot et hallach. bamme devarim amurim bemiddot hallach vehayyavesh shehayu bammikdash kemo shebbearnu behilchot kele hammikdash. aval hammizrakot mekaddeshot hallach vehayyavesh. uchele sharet mekaddeshin dam happasul likkarev:

Kol kele hashsharet en mekaddeshin ella bammikdash veen mekaddeshin ella middaat veen mekaddeshin ella mittochan veen mekaddeshin ella shelemim. nikkevu im osin meen melachtan shehayu osin vehem shelemim mekaddeshin veim lav en mekaddeshin. veen mekaddeshin ella melein. aval hammiddot en mekaddeshot chaserot ella im dato lemalleotan. veim en dato lemalleotan mekaddeshot lehippasel aval lo likkarev:

Kele sharet mekaddeshin shello bizmannan lehippasel aval lo lehikkarev. ketzad. davar shemmitzvato bayyom shennitkaddesh bichli sharet ballayla nifsal veyissaref. aval eno karev. kegon shekkamatz mincha ballayla venatan kumtzah lichli sharet hare zo nisrefet:

Mizbeach shennifgam nifselu kol hakkadashim shehayu sham shechutin bammikdash sheadayin lo nizrak damam. shehare en sham mizbeach lizrok alav veneemar <small>(Shemot 20 21)</small> "vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha" kelomar tizbach vehu omed betikkuno lo pagum:
Aval kadashim chayyim shehayu sham baazara keshennifgam lo nifselu. ella kesheyyibbane hammizbeach yikkarvu sheen baale chayyim nidchin:
Hikdish behemot ad shello nivna hammizbeach. kesheyyibbane makrivin otan shehaddachuy meikkaro eno dachuy:

Vechen en ochlin kadashim vehammizbeach pagum. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 12)</small> "veichluha matztzot etzel hammizbeach". vehu haddin lekadashim kallim sheen ochlin otan birushalayim vehammizbeach pagum ad sheyyibbane:

Velad chattat utemurat chattat vechattat shemmetu bealeha vechattat sheavda venimtzet achar shekkipperu habbealim hare ellu yamutu. nimtzet achar shennishchata hachattat hashsheniyya shehifrish kodem sheyyizzarek damah. hare zo safek im tamut im tire ad sheyyippol bah mum. lefichach tamut. vechetzad hen metot. lo sheyyahargem bichli o beyado ella yachnisem levayit venoel alehem ad sheyyamutu. udevarim ellu kullam mippi moshe rabbenu nishmeu. en kol haddevarim amurim ella bechattat yachid bilvad. aval chattat tzibbur sheavda venimtzet achar kappara ben reuya ben enah reuya tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyippelu dameha lindava. veen atta yachol lomar bechattat tzibbur valad o temura o shemmetu bealeha. shekkol karbenot hatztzibbur zecharim veen hatztzibbur osin temura kemo sheyyitbaer veen kol yisrael metim:
Par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen. vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen. yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava. sheen chattat hatztzibbur meta. velamma lo yikrevu atzman nedava shehare zecharim hem. gezera leachar kappara mishshum lifne kappara:
Hammafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzet harishona vahare shetehem omdot. mashach achat mishshetehen venitkapper bah haacheret tamut. ba lehimmalech omrin lo sheyyitkapper bazo shehifrish barishona vehashsheniyya tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava. hayta achat mehen temima veachat baalat mum. temima tikkarev uvaalat mum tippade. nishchata baalat mum kodem sheyyizzarek dam hattemima hare zo asura bahanaa. hayu shetehen baale mumin yimmachru shetehen veyavi middemehem chattat vehashshear yippol lindava:
Hifrish chattato veavda. vehifrish acheret tachteha veavda. vehifrish acheret venimtzeu haovdot vahare shelashtan omdot venitkapper barishona. sheniyya meta ushelishit roa. nitkapper bashshelishit sheniyya meta verishona roa. nitkapper baemtzait shetehem metot:
Hammafrish shete chattaot leacharayut. mitkapper bee zo sheyyirtze vehashsheniyya tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava:
Hifrish chattat meubberet veyalda. hare hi uveladah kishte chattaot shennitparshu leacharayut:
Hammafrish chattato veavra shenatah. tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bedameha acheret. vechen im hifrish chattato venafal bah mum yavi bedameha acheret:
Kol chattat sheavda venimtzet kodem kappara. (af al pi shennimtzet baalat mum o shennimtzet achar sheavra shenatah) enah meta ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava. nimtzet achar kappara af al pi shennimtzet baalat mum o avra shenatah hoil vehayta avuda bishat kappara hare zo tamut:
Hayta genuva o gezula bishat kappara veachar kach chazra. enah meta ella tire. lo shamu mimmoshe rabbenu ella avuda. hayta ikkar avedatah ballayla af al pi shehayta avuda bishat kappara. enah meta ella tire:
Avda mimmennu velo min haroe. o sheavda min haroe veenah avuda mibbealeha. enah meta ella roa:
Vechol ellu sheroot root ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyippelu demehen lindava:
Hayta avuda mimmennu umin haroe veacher makkira. afillu besof haolam. hare zo safek lefichach tamut:
Hayta nechbet achore haddelet o beseter hammadrega hare zo avuda. shehare en adam roe otah bishat kappara. hayta bassade o baagam hare zo safek avuda shemma yesh sham adam roe otah bishat kappara. lefichach tamut missafek:
Hashsholeach chattato mimmedinat hayyam. makrivin otah bechezkat shehu kayyam. bamme devarim amurim bechattat haof. o bechattat behema shel ishsha sheenah bat semicha kemo shebbearnu. aval asham vadday shemmetu bealav. veshekkipperu bealav. yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava. shekkol shebbechattat tamut beasham yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippelu damav lindava:
Kol asham shennittak liriyya. im hikrivo ola kasher. velamma lo yikkarev beatzmo ola lechattechilla. gezera leachar kappara mishshum lifne kappara:
Hammafrish nekeva laashamo tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bedameha asham. im hikriv ashamo yippelu dameha lindava. vechen veladah:
Hifrish nekeva leolato veyalda zachar yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyavi bedamav ola:
Aval hedyot shehifrish zachar lechattat venasi shehifrish seira lechattat. vechohen mashiach shehifrish para lechattat hare ellu en mitkaddeshin lo kedushshat hagguf velo kedushshat damim. lefichach yimmachru shello bemum:
Hevi asham taluy venoda lo shello chata o shechata vadday. im ad shello nishchat yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippelu damav lindava mippene shellibbo shel adam dave al avonotav vehoil veal safek hifrisho gamar belibbo lehakedish. hifrish afillu al pi edim vehuzammu yippelu damav lindava. veim achar shennishchat noda lo. haddam yishshafech vehabbasar yissaref kishar pesule hammukdashin. noda lo achar shennizrak haddam. habbasar yeachel lakkohanim kechol haashamot:
Asham vadday eno ken. im ad shello nishchat noda lo shello chata yetze veyire baeder kishar hachullin veen bo kedushsha kelal. veim mishshennishchat hare ze yikkaver. veim mishshennizrak haddam. habbasar yetze levet hasserefa kishar pesule hammukdashin:
Mi shennitchayyev beasham taluy vehifrish shenayim leacharayut. mitkapper beechad vehashsheni yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippelu damav lindava. veen tzarich lomar beasham vadday shehu ken:
Kol haashamot shebbattora bain bene shetayim uvaim bechesef shekalim. chutz measham metzora vaasham nazir shehem bene shana veen lidmehem kitzva. asham taluy ba min hakketannim o min haggedolim. umippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno ba ella bechesef shekalim:
Huzelu elim velo yimmatze ayil bishte selaim en lo takkana ella yishhe ad sheyyukeru veyavi bishte selaim shehare hikpida tora al damav venatna lo kitzva:
Hifrish ashamo vehaya bishat haferasha yafe sela uvishat kappara yafe shetayim kasher. shehaddachuy meikkaro eno dachuy vaadayin lo nire ad shennaasa shave shetayim. veaf al pi shehishbiach meelav adam mitkapper beshevach hekdesh. haya bishat haferasha yafe shetayim uvishat kappara yafe sela hare ze pasul. chazar venaasa yafe shetayim yachzor lechashruto sheen baale chayyim nidchin kemo shebbearnu. lema haddavar dome lemum shennafal veavar:
Hifrish shete selaim leasham velakach bahem shene elim leasham. im haya echad mehen yafe shete selaim yikkarev laashamo vehashsheni yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippelu damav lindava:
Haya chayyav beasham ben shana vehevi ben shetayim o beven shetayim vehevi ben shana. o sheshshechato mechussar zeman babbealim. pasul uteebbar tzurato veyetze levet hasserefa. ze hakkelal kol happasul bechattat pasul beasham. chutz min haasham sheshshechato shello lishmo shehu kasher kemo sheyyitbaer:
Olat nazir. olat yoledet. olat metzora. sheshshechatan bene shenem asar chodesh veyom echad. o mechussere zeman bivalim. kesherim uteunin nesachim. ze hakkelal kol sheeno posel beolat nedava eno posel beolat chova. ben alta labbealim ben shello alta lahem:

Hammafrish maot lechattato umet yelchu hammaot leyam hammelach. vechen hammafrish maot lechattato veavdu vehikriv chattat tachtehen venimtzeu hammaot achar kappara yelchu leyam hammelach:
Hifrish maot lechattato veavdu vehifrish maot acherot tachtehen. velo hispik likkach bahen chattat ad shennimtzeu maot harishonot. yavi meellu veellu lechattat vehashshear yippelu lindava:
Hifrish maot lechattato veavdu vehifrish chattat tachtehen velo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzeu hammaot vahare hachattat baalat mum. timmacher veyavi meellu veellu chattat vehashshear yippelu lindava:
Hifrish chattato veavda vehifrish maot tachteha velo hispik likkach bahem ad shennimtzet chattato vahare hi baalat mum. timmacher veyavi meellu veellu chattat vehashshear yippelu lindava:
Hifrish shene tzibbure maot leacharayut. mitkapper beechad mehem vehashsheni yippol lindava:
Hammafrish chattato o deme chattato vechassavur shehu chayyav venimtza sheeno chayyav. hare ellu chullin velo nitkaddeshu. hifrish shetayim o deme shetayim vechassavur shehu chayyav shetayim venimtza sheeno chayyav ella achat. yavi achat vehashshear yippelu lindava:
Hallokeach maot beyado o shehaya melakket veamar ellu avi mehem chattati. hammotar chullin. vechen yerae li shehaddavar kal vachomer bishar hakkarbanot shehammotar chullin:
Hammafrish maot leminchat chote vehevi mehem minchato. o shehifrish minchat chote vehotira. hammotar yavi minchat nedava. aval motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol shehi hachavitin yerakev. vechen motar lachme toda umotar lachmo shel nazir yerakvu. umotar deme nesachav yippelu lindava. kevar bearnu bishkalim shemmotar hashshekalim chullin:
Motar kinne zavim. kinne zavot. kinne yoldot. chattaot vaashamot. motrehem yippelu lindava veyikkarvu olot kemo shebbearnu. motar ola leola. motar shelamim lishlamim. motar mincha lemincha. motar pesach lishlamim. motar nezirim linzirim. motar nazir leoto nazir. bamme devarim amurim shemmotar chattat lindava. bechattat kevua. aval mi shehu chayyav bekarban ole veyored shehifrish maot lechattat behema veheeni. mevi tachtehem of umechallelan al haof veyehane mehem. vechen im hifrish deme haof veheeni. mevi tachtehem asirit haefa vichallel hammaot aleha veyehane bahem:
Hifrish behema venafal bah mum. timmacher veyavi bedameha of. aval im hifrish of venifsal. lo yavi bedamav asirit haefa. sheen laof pidyon kemo shebbearnu beissure hammizbeach:
Kol chayyave kinnin shebbattora shehifrishu maot lekinnehen. ratza lehavi bechol hammaot chattat haof levaddah yavi. ratza lehavi bahen olat haof levaddah yavi. afillu amar ellu deme chattati veellu deme olati. yesh lo learev hammaot velikkach bahen keechad chattato veolato. o likkach bakkol chattat o ola. sheen hakkinnin mitparshot ella bilkichat habbealim o baasiyyat kohen:
Lefichach im hifrish maot lekinnin setam umet. yippelu kol otan hammaot hassetumin lindava. shehare kullan reuyin lavo ola:
Mi shehaya mechuyyav chattat veamar hare alay ola vehifrish maot veamar ellu lechovati. ratza lehavi bahen chattat behema yavi. olat behema yavi. met vehinniach hammaot yelchu leyam hammelach:

Kol hazzevachim shennitarev bahen achat mechattaot hammetot. o shor hanniskal. afillu echad beribbo kullan yamutu lefi shebbaale chayyim chashuvin hen veenam betelin. veim hikriv hurtza sheen baale chayyin nidchin:
Nitarev bahen echad meissure hammizbeach. yiru kullam ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyimmachru veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen meoto hammin shel kadashim shennitarev:
Nitarvu kadashim bechullin temimim yimmachru hachullin shebbattaarovet letzarche oto hammin veyikkarvu kullan. ketzad. arba behemot shelamim shennitarvu bearba behemot chullin temimim. yimmachru haarba shel chullin lemi shehu tzarich lehavi shelamim veyikkarvu hakkol shelamim. vechen beola o beasham. vehaddamim chullin lechol davar shehare deme chullin hen:
Nitarev shor hekdesh bishvarim shel chol. gadol shebbechullan hekdesh veyimmachru hashshear letzarche oto hammin. nitarvu kadashim bekadashim min bemino. ze yikrav leshem bealav veze yikrav leshem bealav af al pi sheen kol echad mehen makkir karbano. bamme devarim amurim bekarbenot nashim sheen bahem semicha. aval karbenot anashim hoil vechol echad tzarich lismoch al rosh karbano hare ellu lo yikkarvu ad sheyyitten haechad chelko lachavero. o ad sheyyippol mum bakkol veyimmachru veyaviu kol echad bidme hayyafe shebbahen meoto hammin:
Nitarvu min besheeno mino kegon ola bishlamim. lo yikkarvu afillu kachamura shebbahen. sheen meviin kadashim levet happasul:
Ucheshem sheen memaatin bizman achilatan kach en memaatin beochlehen velo bimkom achilatan. ella ketzad yaase. yiru hakkol ad sheyyippol bahem mum veyimmacher kol echad mehen levaddo veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze uvidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin haacher veyafsid hammotar mibbeto:
Af al pi shekkevar hikriv ola shechayyav bah o shelamim shehaya chayyav lehakerivan. hare ze makriv middeme hattaarovet ola acheret ushelamim acherim:
Chattat shennitarva bishlamim yiru hakkol ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen shelamim uvidme hayyafe shebbahen chattat. veim kadam vehikriv chattat acheret al chattat shehifrishah lo kullan yamutu:
Vechen im nitarvu meot chattat bimot asham. lokeach shete behemot umechallel deme chattat bechol makom shehu al chattat udeme asham al asham. veim kevar karva chattato yolich kol hammaot leyam hammelach. veim kevar karva ashamo yippelu hakkol lindava:
Toda shennitarva bitmuratah shetehen tikkaravna veyanif hallechem immahen. vechach im nitarva toda bishar zevachim af al pi shekkarva todato yiru hakkol ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidme hayyafe toda acheret. uvidme hayyafe zevach acher:
Nitarva beel nazir shetehem tikkaravna veyanif hallechem immahen:
Bechor shennitarev befesach shenehem yiru ad sheyyippol bahem mum veyeachlu kivchor. velamma lo yikkarvu. lefi shehappesach neechol lechol adam ad chatzot vehabbechor lishne yamim veeno neechol ella lakkohanim. veen meviin kadashim levet happesul veen memaatin baachilatan:
Vechen maaser shennitarev befesach kesheyyippol bahen mum yeachlu kemaaser. habbechor vehammaaser shennitarvu yeachlu bemuman:
Vechen shear kadashim shennitarvu bivchor uvemaaser yiru ad sheyyippol bahem mum veyeachlu kivchor shennafal bo mum o kemaaser shennafal bo mum:
Asham shennitarev bishlamim. af al pi sheen makrivin mishshenehen ella haemurin aval habbasar neechol. lo yikkarvu ella yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidme hayyafe asham uvidme hayyafe shelamim vehammotar yafsid mibbeto. veim kadam vehikriv ashamo shenehen yippelu lindava:
Kol hakkadashim efshar sheyyitarvu min bemino. chutz min hachattat im haasham sheen haasham ella mizzichre kevasim. veen lecha chattat min hakkevasim ella nekeva:
Vechol ellu hammitarvin bachayyim im hikriv hurtza sheen baale chayyim nidchin:
Behema shennimtzet mirushalayim vead migdal eder uchemiddata lechol ruach. im nekeva bat shenatah hi konsah lechippa ad shettamut shemma chattat hi. hayta bat shetayim yevienna shelamim veyavi immah lechem shemma toda hi. matza zachar ben shete shanim en lo takkana. shemma asham hu vaadayin lo kipperu bealav. matza zachar ben shana mannicho ad sheyyippol bo mum. umevi shete behemot tachtav umatne veomer im ola haya ze ola tachtav veim shelamim haya ze shelamim tachtav. umakriv haechad ola unesachav mishshel tzibbur. vehaacher shelamim im hallechem shemma toda haya. uma yaase baze hannimtza yeachel bemumo sheafillu haya bechor o maaser bemumo hu neechol. veim pesach achar zemanno hu hare ze shelamim uvizmanno hakkol nizharin bo. veim tomar shemma asham nazir o asham metzora hu. enan metzuyin tamid. lefichach lo chashu lahen:
Nitarvu kadashim bekadashim achar shennishchatu yeachlu kechamur shebbahen. nitarvu bifsule hammukdashin o bechullin shennishchatu baazara teubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa:
Evre chattat shennitarvu beevre ola. mannichin hakkol ad sheyyippasdu uteubbar tzuratan. vesorfin otan baazara bemakom shessorfin pesule hammukdashin:
Evar shel baale mumin shennitarev beevre kadashim afillu evar beelef evarim. yetzu hakkol levet hasserefa. vaafillu karvu kullan chutz meechad min hattaarovet. hare ze yissaref baazara bemakom shessorfin pesule hammukdashin:
Chatichot kadshe kadashim shennitarvu bachatichot kadashim kallim. o hanneechalin leyom echad beneechalin lishne yamim. yeachlu kechamur shebbahen:
Chaticha shel chattat temea shennitarva bemea chatichot shel chattat tehora. vechen perusa shel lechem happanim shennitma shennitarva bemea perusot shel lechem happanim hattahor. hare zo taale kemo shebbearnu bitrumot:
Aval chaticha shel chattat shennitarva bemea chatichot shel chullin. vechen perusa shel lechem happanim hattahor shennitarva bemea perusot shel chullin. hare ellu lo yaalu ella yeachel hakkol lakkohanim kechol hamedummaot:

Kol happesulin laavoda shemmalku melikatan pesula. veaf al pi sheoto haof pasul eno kenivlat haof hattahor letuma. vechen im malak ballayla o sheshshachat chullin bifnim vekadashim bachutz. enah kinvela:
Malak torim shello higgia zemannan uvene yona sheavar zemannam vesheyyavash gappah veshennismet enah veshenniktea raglah hare zo nevela lechol davar. ze hakkelal kol shehaya pesulah bakkodesh pesula veenah nevela. lo haya pesulah bakkodesh hare zo nevela lechol davar:
Lefichach hammolek venimtzet terefa. o shemmalak besakkin o shemmalak chullin bifnim vekadashim bachutz. hare zo nevela lechol davar. sheen hammelika matteret umetaheret ella davar shehu kasher lammizbeach:
Aval hannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad vehaetnan vehammechir vehattumtum vehaanderoginus shennimleku. hare ellu nevela lechol davar umetammein begadim bevet habbelia. sheen hakkedushsha chala alehen vahare en pesulan bekodesh:
Kevar bearnu bemaase hakkarbanot shechattat haof naaset lematta veolat haof lemala. chattat haof sheasaah lemala pesula. ben sheasa hazzayatah kemaase chattat. ben sheasaah kemaase ola. ben sheasaah leshem ola. ben sheasaah leshem chattat:
Vechen olat haof sheasaah lematta afillu malak siman echad lematta vesiman echad lemala pesula ben shemmelako kimlikat ola ben sheasaah kemaase chattat. ben sheasaah leshem chattat ben sheasaah leshem ola:
Chattat haof shemmelakah lematta kimlikat ola leshem chattat o kemaase chattat leshem ola o kemaase ola leshem ola pesula:
Vechen olat haof sheasaah lemala kemaase chattat leshem ola o kemaase chattat leshem chattat pesula. kemaase ola leshem chattat keshera. uvilvad shello alta labbealim leshem chova:
Kol ellu haofot shennifselu mippene mekom asiyyatan o mippene shinnuy maasehen o shinnuy shemam. enan kenivlat haof letuma. vechen chattat haof o olat haof shennitpaggela o nitmea o naaset notar enah metammea bevet habbelia kenivlat haof. shekkol ellu pesulan bekodesh:
Chattat haof habbaa al hassafek naaset kemitzvatah veenah neechelet ella tissaref kechol pesule hammukdashin. vechetzad tavo al hassafek. kegon shehayta haishsha sefek zava o sefek yoledet vechol kayyotze baze. veen lanu chattat behema al safek. sheim nistappek lo im chata im lo chata yavi asham taluy kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot shegagot:
Chattat haof habbaa al hassafek venoda shehi chayyevet bah vadday. im ad shello nimleka noda lah tease vaddait veteachel. veim achar shennimleka noda lah hare ze gomer hazzayat damah vetamtzito vetissaref kede shello yomru chattat haof habbaa al hassafek teachel shehare battechilla al safek baa:
Noda lah sheenah chayyevet bah meachar shennimleka hare zo tikkaver:

Chatat haof shennitarva beolat haof. o olat haof shennitarva bechattat haof. afillu achat beribbo kullan yamutu. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu meforashot bishat lekichat habbealim zo chattat vezo ola. aval im hevi ofot lechovato mehen chattat umehen ola velo peresh ella kullan setumot venitarva chattat o ola bechova zo hassetuma yesh lahen dinim acherim:
Vechetzad dinehen. im nitarva chattat bechova zo hassetuma en kasher ella minyan chattaot shebbechova bilvad. aval minyan haolot shebbechova im hachattat shennitarva bahen pesulin shehare nitarva chattat veolot:
Lefichach im hayta hachova shetayim bechattat. chatzi hachova kasher vechetzyah pasul. veyerae li shehu ose kullan lemattan kemaase chattat:
Vechen im nitarva ola bechova zo hassetuma. en kasher ella minyan olot shebbechova. aval minyan hachattaot shebbechova im haola shennitarva bahen pesulin. shehare nitarva ola bechattat. ben shehayta hachova hassetuma merubba al haolot shennitarev bah. ben shehayu haolot merubbin al hachova hassetuma. ben shehayu shetehen shavot. en kasher ella minyan olot shebbechova. lefichach im hayta hachova shetayim baolot chatzi hachova kasher vechetzyah pasul. veyerae li shehu ose kullan lemala kemaase ola:
Chova setuma vechova acheret setuma shennitarvu. ben shehayu shetehen mishshem echad. kegon kinne zavim im kinne zavim. o mishshene shemot kegon kinne zavim im kinne yoldot. ben shehayu shetehem leadam echad. ben shehayu lishnayim. im hayu shetehen shavot mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. ben sheasa hakkol lemala o hakkol lematta o asa chetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta leolam mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. mippene shehakkol chetzyan ola vechetzyan chattat. vehachattat lematta vehaola lemala. im asa hakkol lemala chetzyan kesherot vehen olot. veim asa kullan lematta chetzyan kesherot vehen chattaot. asa chetzyan lematta vechetzyan lemala chatzi hachetzi shennaasa lemala kasher mippene hattaarovet vehu olot vachatzi hachetzi shel matta kasher vehu chattaot:
Hayu shete hachovot hassetumot shennitarvu zo gedola mizzo. kegon shehayta achat arba ofot vehashsheniyya shesh. im asa hakkol lemala o asa hakkol lematta mechetza pasul umechetza kasher umittaam shebbearnu. asa chetzyan lematta vechetzyan lemala. im achar sheshshaal asa chen hammuat kasher. veim middato asa hamerubbe kasher:
Ze hakkelal kol sheasa hakkohen middato chetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta. vei efshar shello yihye mishshel echad lemala ulematta. hare ze hamerubbe kasher hoil vedavar yadua shemmiktzat karbenotav lemala umiktzatam lematta yihyu kol karbenotav kesherim:
Shenayim shellakchu kinnehen beeruv o shennatnu deme kinnehen lakkohen leeze sheyyirtze hakkohen yakriv chattat uleeze sheyyirtze yakriv ola. sheen hakkinin mitparshin ella bilkichat habbealim o baasiyyat hakkohen kemo shebbearnu:
Hayu lifne hakkohen chattaot veolot. asa shetehen lemala o shetehen lematta mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. asa chetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta velo yada im hachattaot hem sheasa lematta o haolot. hare hakkol pasul. sheani omer haolot hem sheasa lematta vehachattaot lemala:
Hayu lefanav shelosha tzibbure ofot echad chattaot veechad olot vehaechad satum chetzyo olot vechetzyo chattaot velo peresh. im asa kullan lemala o lematta. mechetza kasher umechetza pasul:
