Parim hannisrafin useirim hannisrafin zorek dam mikkol echad mehem sheva hazzayot al happarochet hammavdelet ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim. vearba hazzayot al arba karnot mizbach hazzahav:
Vechol haddamim hannittanin al mizbach hazzahav keshehu nichnas omed ben hammizbeach lammenora vehammizbeach lefanav. venoten al karnot hammizbeach mibbachutz. matchil mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit litzfonit maaravit lemaaravit deromit lidromit mizrachit:
Par kohen mashiach habba al kol hammitzvot kohen hammashiach atzmo mekabbel damo umazze mimmennu mibbifnim veim kibbel vehizza kohen hedyot kasher:
Seire avoda zara vehen seirin hannisrafin lo nitparesh bahen battora ketzad noten daman ulehechan hu noten. ella lefi shehen chattat hakkahal dinan kedin par helem shehu chattat hakkahal lechol haamur bo lemattan damim velisrefa uletamme et hassoref:
Habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach dam kol echad mehen taun mattana achat bishficha keneged hayesod bee zo ruach sheyyirtze mishshelosh zaviyyot hammizbeach. shehare keren mizrachit deromit lo haya lah yesod kemo shebbearnu. uminnayin sheenan teunin ella mattana achat shehare neemar bivchor <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "veet damam tizrok al hammizbeach" mippi hashshemua lamdu shehu haddin bemaaser uvefesach shennoten daman mattana achat kivchor:
Kol hazzevachim maktirin emurehen al gabbe hammizbeach achar shezzorkin haddam techilla. vechol hazzevachim mafshitin otan veachar kach motziin et emurehen. veen mafshitin otan ad sheyyizzarek haddam. chutz mechataot hannisrafot sheen mafshitin otam kelal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 27)</small> "et oram veet besaram". nimtzeta omer zorek techilla veachar kach mafshit vekorea umotzi haemurin umaktir:
Kol orot kadshe hakkadashim lakkohanim ben bekarbenot tzibbur ben bekarbenot yachid shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 8)</small> "or haola asher hikriv". aval orot kadashim kallim labbealim. vechol ola shello zacha hammizbeach bivsarah lo zachu hakkohanim beorah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 8)</small> "lat ish" ola shealta leish:
Kol kadshe hakkadashim sheera bahen pissul kodem hefshetan en orotehen lakkohanim. leachar hefshetan oran lakkohanim. vechol haorot mechallekin otan anshe mishmar benehen meerev shabbat leerev shabbat:
Hammatpis olato levedek habbayit. vechen hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen zecharim sheddinan sheyyikkarvu olot en orotehen lakkohanim shenneemar olat ish perat leolat hekdesh. ella yimmachru haorot veyippelu levedek habbayit. echad <small>(Vayikra 7 8)</small> "olat ish" o ishsha o akkum o eved orotehen lakkohanim lo neemar ish ella lehotzi hahekdesh:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 6: Mitzvat ase laasot haola kemishpatah hakketuva battora. vechetzad maase haola. shochet vezorek haddam kemo shebbearnu. umafshit umenatteach umaktir kol hannetachim al gabbe hammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 9)</small> "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha":

Tzemer shebberashe kevasim vesear shebbizkan hatteyashim vehaatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim bizman shehen mechubbarin maktirin et hakkol. veim parshu lo yaalu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 27)</small> "olotecha habbasar vehaddam". vechullan sheppaku meal hammizbeach lo yachzir. vechen gachelet sheppaka meal hammizbeach lo yachzir:

Evarim sheppaku meal hammizbeach im yesh bahen mammash afillu paku achar chatzot hallayla yachzir. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayla". veim en bahem mammash afillu paku kodem chatzot lo yachzir. nitcharech habbasar veyavash alehen keetz ufaku kodem chatzot yachzir achar chatzot lo yachzir:

Keshemmenatteach evre haola molichin et kol hannetachim lakkevesh umolchin otam sham. veachar kach maalin kol haevarim lerosh hammizbeach. umesir gid hannashe berosh hammizbeach umashlicho al gabbe haddeshen shebbeemtza hammizbeach. vezorek kol haevarim al haesh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 27)</small> "habbasar vehaddam". keshem shehaddam bizrika kach kol habbasar bizrika. veachar shezzorkan chozer veorech otan al haesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 12)</small> "vearach hakkohen otam". veevarim shetztzelaan veachar kach heelan lammizbeach en bahem mishshum reach nichoach:

Ketzad menattechin et haola. lo haya shover et haregel ella nokvo vetole bo umafshit. veim haya shor mafshito beli teliyya. umafshit ad shehu maggia lechaze. higgia lechaze chotech et harosh venotno lakkohen. vechotech et hakkeraayim venotnan leacher umashlim et hahefshet. vekorea et hallev umotzi et damo. vechotech et hayyadayim venotnan leacher. ala leregel yemini chotcho venotno lemi shezzacha barosh ushete betzim immah. veachar kach korea et habbehema ad sheyyiggalu (et) hammeayim. venotel et happeder venotno al harosh millemala al bet hashshechita. venotel et hakkeravayim venotnan leacher:

Holech umedichan bammayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 13)</small> "vehakkerev vehakkeraayim yirchatz bammayim". lo beyayin velo bemezeg velo bishar mashkin. vechol hammemot kesherin. kamma medichan. hakkares medichin otah bevet [hammedichin] kol tzarkah. hakkeravayim en pochatin mishshalosh peamim. umedichin otan al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim:

Natal et hassakkin vehifrish et harea min hakkaved veetzba hakkaved min hakkaved veeno meziz hakkaved mimmekomo. venokev et hechaze venotno leacher. veole laddofen hayemanit vechotech veyored ad hashshidra velo yigga bashshidra. ad shehu maggia lishte tzelaot rakkot chotchah venotnah leacher vehakkaved teluya bah:

Ba lo laggera manniach bah shete tzelaot mikkan ushete tzelaot mikkan. chotchah venotnah leacher vehakkane vehallev veharea teluyin bah. ba lo laddofen hassemalit umanniach bah shete tzelaot rakkot millemala ushete tzelaot rakkot millematta vechach haya manniach bachavertah. nimtza manniach bishte haddefanot arba tzelaot bezo vearba tzelaot bezo. chotchah venotnah leacher vehashshidra immah vehattechol taluy bah:

Ba lo laoketz chotcho venotno leacher. vehaalya veetzba hakkaved ushete kelayot immah. notel et haregel hassemalit venotnah leacher. ucheseder ze mafshitin umenattechin olat behema. veellu hen hannetachin haamurin battora <small>(Vayikra 1 6)</small> "venittach otah lintacheha":
Bechamma molichin et haevarim lakkevesh. im min hatztzon hi haola molichin otah shishsha:
Harishon barosh uvaregel. harosh bimino vechatmo kelappe zeroo. vekarnav ben etzbeotav. uvet shechita lemala vehappeder aleha veharegel shel yamin bismolo uvet orah lachutz:
Hashsheni bishte hayyadayim shel yamin bimino veshel semol bismolo uvet oran lachutz:
Hashshelishi baoketz uvaregel. haoketz bimino vehaalya medeldelet ben etzbeotav veetzba hakkaved ushete hakkelayot immo veharegel shel semolo bismolo uvet oran lachutz:
Harvii bechaze uvaggera. hechaze bimino vehaggera bismolo vetzaloteha ben etzbeotav:
Hachamishi bishte defanot shel yamin bimino veshel semol bismolo uvet oran lachutz:

Hashshishshi bakkeravayim netunin bevazach ucheraayim al gabbehen millemala. im hayta haola keves o ez. aval im hayta ayil molichin hakkeravayim shenayim. vechen hassolet shel nesacheha beyad echad vehayyayin beyad acher. veim haya ayil hassolet bishnayim vehayyayin bishnayim:
Nimtzeta lamed shehakkeves o haez molichin oto shemona lammizbeach. vehaayil molichin oto achad asar:

Hashshor molichin oto arbaa veesrim. harishon molich et harosh. vehashsheni vehashshelishi molichin haregel shel yamin. veharvii vehachamishi molichin et haoketz. vehashshishshi vehashshevii molichin et haregel shel semol. vehashshemini molich et hechaze. vehaggera molichin otah shelosha. teshii vaasiri veachad asar. umolichin shete hayyadayim bishnayim. ushete haddefanot bishnayim. vehakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishlosha shelosha hare arbaa veesrim:

Velamma lo yechalleku haevar haggadol shel shor lachalakim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 6)</small> "venittach otah lintacheha" velo netacheha lintachim. bamme devarim amurim beolot hatztzibbur. aval olot hayyachid im ratzu leholich netacheha befachot meellu o beyoter molichin:

Olat haof ketzad hayta naaset. ole lakkevesh ufana lassovev uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit vehaya molek sham et roshah mimmul arpah umavdil. veim lo hivdil pesula. umematztze dam harosh vedam hagguf al kir hammizbeach lemala min hachut shebbeemtza hammizbeach. veim mitztza dam harosh velo mitztza dam hagguf pesula. mitztza dam hagguf velo mitztza dam harosh keshera:

Venotel et harosh umakkif bet melikato lammizbeach vesofgo bemelach vezorko al gabbe haishshim. uva lo lagguf vehesir et hammura vehaor shealeha beyado im hannotza veet bene meayim hayyotzin immah umashlichan levet haddeshen:

<small>(Vayikra 1 17)</small> "veshissa oto vichnafav". beyado belo sakkin. veeno tzarich lehavedil shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 17)</small> "lo yavdil" veim hivdil kasher. vesofgo bemelach vezorko al gabbe haishshim. lo hesir et hammura velo et hannotza velo et bene meayim velo sefagah bemelach kol sheshshinna bah meachar tamtzit haddam keshera:

Ketzad molkin. kotzetz veyored batztzipporen mimmul oref. im ratza leholich ulehavi molich umevi. veim ratza lihyot dores veyored batztzipporen dores. veim neekru hassimanim eno choshesh. vechotech shidra umifreket belo rov basar. sheim chatach rov basar hare zo kemeta kodem sheyyaggia lassimanin. vetzarich lachtoch shene hassimanim baola keshehu yored. vehammolek besakkin o min hatztzedadin enah melika ella kemi shechanak o nachar. vechol haoref kasher limlika:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 7: Mitzvat ase laasot hachattaot kemitzvatan haamura battora. vechetzad maase chattat hanneechelet. shochet venoten haddam kemo shebbearnu. umafshitah umafrish haemurim umolchan vezorkan al gabbe haishshim. veim ratza litten et haemurin bichli keshemmolichan lammizbeach noten ushear besarah neechol lezichre kehunna baazara:

Vechetzad maase chattaot hannisrafot. shochet vezorek damam kemo shebbearnu. veachar kach koram umotzi haemurim venotnan bichli umolchan vezorkan al gabbe haishshim. umotzi sheeritan chutz lair. umenattechin otan sham kenitche haola beoran. vesorfin otan sham bevet haddeshen:

Shelosha mekomot lisrefa. echad betoch haazara uvo sorfin pesule hammukdashin veemure kadashim kallim shennifselu ufarim useirim shel chattaot hannisrafot im era bahem pasul ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika. kegon shennitmeu o sheyyatzu chutz laazara ad shello higgia zemannan latzet. o shellan habbasar o lanu haemurin shellahen:

Vehammakom hashsheni behar habbayit ushemo bira. uvo sorfin chattaot hannisrafot im era bahen pesul achar tzetan min haazara. vehammakom hashshelishi chutz lirushalayim vehu hannikra bet haddeshen. vesham sorfin chattaot hannisrafot bizman shehen nisrafot kemitzvatan:

Userefat kol hannisrafin keshera bezar uvallayla. vechol hannisrafin chutz laazara kol haetzim kesherin lisrefatan afillu bekash uvigvava shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 12)</small> "al etzim baesh", esh mikkol makom. velamma neemar etzim lehotzi et hassid veet haremetz:

Chattat haof ketzad hayta naaset. molek otah bekeren deromit maaravit kemo shebbearnu veyored betzipparno ad sheyyachtoch hassimanin o rov echad mehen veeno mavdil harosh min hagguf. veim hivdil pasal veloke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 8)</small> "umalak et rosho mimmul arpo velo yavdil". umazze middamah al kir hammizbeach lematta meemtzao. usheyare haddam mitmatztzim al hayesod shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 9)</small> "vehannishar baddam yimmatze al yesod hammizbeach" mikkelal shehannetina al kir shehashsheyarin shello mitmatztzin el yesod vezehu kir hattachton:
Umitztzuy dam chattat haof meakkev. veen lammizbeach bah ella damah vehashshear neechol lezichre kehunna kivsar chattat habbehema:

Ketzad ochez chattat haof bishat melika. ochez shete ragleha ben shete etzbeotav ushete agappeha ben shete etzbeotav. umoteach tzavvarah el rochav shete etzbeotav umolek. vezo meavodot kashot shebbammikdash. veim shinna veachaz bechol makom keshera:
Vechol makom min hammizbeach kasher limlikatah. uvilvad sheyyazze damah lematta meemtza hammizbeach. veim hizza bechol makom keshera. vehu sheyyitten lematta meat middam hannefesh:

Shelosha devarim hayta keren deromit maaravit meshammeshet lemala ushelosha lematta. millematta chattat haof vehaggashat hammenachot usheyare haddam shel olot vechattaot hanneechalot vaashamot ushelamim sheshshofchin aleha. vehashshelosha shel mala nissuch hammayim shemmenassechin bechag venissuch hayyayin shel nesachim veolat haof bizman shehi rabba. veim en keren deromit mizrachit mechila otah nifnin lekeren deromit maaravit veosin otah sham:

Kol haolin lammizbeach olin derech yamin umakkifin veyordin derech semol. chutz min haole leechad mishshelosha devarim ellu shellemala bekeren zo shehen olin venifnin al hassemol lakkeren veosin melachtan vechozrin laakev. umippene ma nifnin lismol kede sheyyifgeu bekeren maaravit deromit techilla. sheim nifnin al yamin umakkifin et kol hammizbeach ad sheyyaggiu lekeren deromit maaravit shemma yitashshen hammayim vehayyayin o shemma yamut haof beeshen hammizbeach:

Lefichach hamenassech mayim o yayin keshehu makkif et hammizbeach lo yihye beyado kelum. umatchil umakkif mikkeren deromit mizrachit lemizrachit tzefonit litzfonit maaravit lemaaravit deromit velo yihye beyado kelum. ucheshemmaggia lemaaravit deromit notnin hammayim o hayyayin beyado umenassech. veim lo hikkif ole ufone al semolo veose melachto veyored:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 8: Chomer bechattat habbehema mishshear kadshe kadashim. sheddam chattat habbehema shennittaz min hakkeli shekkibbel bo haddam kodem hazzaya al habbeged taun kibbus bemayim baazara shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 20)</small> "vaasher yizze middamah al habbeged asher yizze aleha techabbes bemakom kadsh":

Echad habbeged veechad haor harach veechad hassak teunin kibbus. aval haor hakkashe hare hu keetz vegored haddam mealav. veechad dam chattat hanneechelet o dam chattat hannisrefet aval lo dam chattat haof. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 18)</small> "tishshachet hachattat" benishchetet hakkatuv medabber lo benimleket:

Chattat shennifsela en damah taun kibbus. ben shehayta lah sheat hakkosher ben shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher. e zo hi shehayta lah sheat hakkosher. shellana veshennitmet vesheyyatzat chutz laazara. vee zo hi shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher. shennifsela bishchita o bizrikat haddam:

En taun kibbus ella mekom haddam bilvad. vehu sheyyihye al keli sherauy lekabbel tuma verauy lechibbus. aval im nittaz al keli etz o keli mattechet eno taun kibbus lefi sheenan reuyin lechibbus ella gordan bilvad:

Nittaz al or haddag eno taun kibbus lefi sheeno rauy lekabbel tuma. aval im nittaz al or behema. ad shello hufshat eno taun kibbus. achar shehufshat taun kibbus. sheaf al pi sheeno mekabbel tuma atta hare hu rauy lekabbel tuma leachar sheyyitabbed:

Nittaz min hatztzavvar al habbeged o meal keren hammizbeach o shennishpach haddam al haritzpa vaasafo venittaz mimmennu al habbeged eno taun kibbus shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 20)</small> "vaasher yizze middamah". lo amarti ella bedam shennitkabbel bichli sharet verauy lehazzaya veyesh bo kede hazzaya:
Natan arba hammattanot veachar kach nittaz min hakkos al habbeged mishsheyare haddam eno taun kibbus. af al pi sheadayin lo zarak hashsheyarim al hayesod. vechen bechattaot hannisrafot:
Nittaz meetzbao achar sheyyatzat hazzaya miyyado eno taun kibbus sheshsheyare haddam shebbaetzba pesulin lehazzaya:

Nittaz min habbeged leveged sheni en habbeged hashsheni taun kibbus. nittaz al beged tame eno taun kibbus. nittaz dam hachattat al habbeged venittaz al dam hachattat dam chullin taun kibbus. aval im nittaz dam hachullin techilla (o afillu dam ola) venittaz alav dam hachattat eno taun kibbus shehare lo nivla bo:

Keshemmechabbesin et mekom haddam mechabbesin oto bemayim yafe yafe ad shello yishshaer lo roshem. vechol shivat hassammanim shemmaavirin al hakketem maavirin al dam chattat. chutz mimme raglayim sheen machnisin me raglayim lammikdash:

Keli cheres shennitbashshela bo hachattat hanneechelet taun shevira baazara. ucheli mattachot shennitbashshela bo taun merika ushetifa bemayim baazara shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 21)</small> "ucheli cheres asher tevushshal bo yishshaver". af al pi shello neemar kan <small>(Vayikra 7 6)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 24)</small> "bemakom kadosh" hare dinan kedin hakkibbus. ma kibbus habbeged bakkodesh af shevirat keli cheres ushetifat keli mattachot umerikato bakkodesh. veechad keli shebbishshel bo o keli sheheera letocho roteach:

Merika bechammin ushetifa betzonen. bemayim lo beyayin velo bemezeg velo bishar mashkin. vehammerika vehashshetifa kimrikat hakkos ushetifato. vehashshippud vehaaskala magilan bemayim chammim al gabbe haesh veachar kach medichan:

Bamme devarim amurim shebbishshel bahen achar shennizrak damah kehilchato. aval im bishshel kodem zerika o shebbishshel bah besar chattat hannisrefet eno taun merika ushetifa. bishshel bemiktzat hakkeli kullo taun merika ushetifa:

Tzala habbasar [baavir] tannur shel cheres yesh baddavar safek im yishshaver hoil venitbashshela bo o lo yishshaver hoil velo naga bo. velo bechattat bilvad ella kol hakkelim shemmishtammeshin bahen bekadashim al yede chammin ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim teunin merika ushetifa ekev achila. vechen hashshippud vehaaskala magilan ekev achila. veeno menichan ad zeman achila sheniyya. ella kesheyyashlim leechol yagil hashshippud vehaaskala vimarek vayyishtof hakkeli ben kele mattachot ben kele cheres chutz min hachattat sheshshover bah kele cheres. umevashshel veshone umeshallesh miyyad ben bichle mattachot ben bichle cheres umemarek veshotef ad sof achila:

Kele gelalim uchele avanim uchele adama enan teunin merika ushetifa afillu bechattat ella hadacha bilvad. neemar bechattat <small>(Vayikra 6 20)</small> "kl asher yigga bivsarah yikdash" lihyot kamoha. im pesula hi hannogea bah pasul veim keshera hannogea bah yeachel kamoha uvikdushshatah:

Bamme devarim amurim keshennivlea bo. aval negia belo havelaa enah mekuddeshet. veechad hachattat veechad shear kadashim ben kadashim kallim ben chamurim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 37)</small> "zot hattora laola velammincha":
Naga besarah berakik venivla bemiktzato lo nitkaddesh kullo ella chotech mekom habbela:

Keli shebbishshel bo kadashim vechullin o kadshe kadashim vekadashim kallim. im yesh bahen benoten taam hare hakkol neechol kechamur shebbahen. vetaun hakkeli merika ushetifa vehakkol kechamur shebbahen lechol davar. veim lo natan taam ze baze en hakkallin neechalin kachamurim veenan kemotan lechol davar. aval hakkeli taun merika ushetifa:

Beged shennittaz alav dam hachattat veyatza chutz laazara machziro laazara umechabbeso sham. nitma chutz laazara ketzad yaase. koro kede sheyyithar umachniso umechabbeso bifnim. vetzarich lehaniach bo shalem kede maaforet lefi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 20)</small> "beged" tzarich lechabbes beged. veaf al pi shehu tame middivrehem mippene kede hammaaforet shennishara bo kevan shennikra rubbo tahor min hattora umuttar lehacheniso lammikdash lechabbes haddam:

Meil shennittaz alav dam chattat veyatza venitma lachutz ketzad hu ose vahare hakkorea oto loke kemo shebbearnu. machniso pachot pachot mishshalosh etzbaot umechabbeso bifnim. veachar sheyyitkabbes kol haddam meat meat matbilin oto bachutz:

Keli cheres shebbishshel bo hachattat veyatza machniso veshovro bifnim. nitma bachutz nokvo bichde shoresh katan kede sheyyithar umachniso veshovro bifnim. veim nikkevo nekev gadol mizze eno shovro bifnim shehare eno keli veen shovrin bifnim ella kelim. vechen keli mattachot shebbishshel bo veyatza chutz laazara machniso umorko veshotfo bifnim. nitma kesheyyatza pochato ad sheyyithar umachniso bifnim vechozer umeraddedo ad sheyyissatem happechat veyachzor ketavnit hakkelim. veachar kach morko veshotfo baazara shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 21)</small> "veim bichli nechshet" vegomer en morkin bifnim ella kelim:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 9:
Mitzvat ase laasot kol haashamot kemitzvatan haamura battora. vechetzad maase haashamot ben asham vadday ben asham taluy. shochet vezorek haddam kemo shebbearnu. umafshit umotzi haemurin umolchan vezorkan al gav haishshim. veim ratza leholichan bichli molich. ushear besaram neechol lezichre kehunna baazara kachattat:
Asham metzora yesh bekabbalat damo shinnuy kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mechussere kappara. veaf al pi chen shear maasav uzerikat damo al hammizbeach vaachilato kishar haashamot lechol davar:
Asiyyat kol shelamim kemitzvatan mitzvat ase vehen arbaa minin. haechad shalme tzibbur vehashshelosha shalme yachid:
Vechetzad maase shalme tzibbur. shochet vezorek haddam kemo shebbearnu. umafshit umotzi haemurim umolchan umaktiran. vehashshear neechol lezichre kehunna baazara kachattat vechaasham mippene shehen kadshe kadashim kemo shebbearnu:
Shalme yachid shelosha minin. haechad hu habba shelamim belo lechem kegon shalme chagiga vesimcha vezehu hannikra shelamim. vehashsheni shelamim habbaim im hallechem beneder o nedava vezehu hannikra toda veoto hallechem nikra lechem toda. vehammin hashshelishi shelamim shemmakriv hannazir beyom melot nizro vehem baim im lechem vezehu hannikra el nazir:
Vechetzad maase shelashtan. shochet vezorek haddam kemo shebbearnu. umafshit umotzi haemurin. veachar kach menatteach et habbasar umafrish hechaze veshok hayyamin venoten haemurin im hechaze vehashshok al yede habbealim vechohen manniach yado tachat yede habbealim umenif hakkol lifne Adonai bammizrach. vechen kol hattaun tenufa bammizrach menifin oto:
Vechetzad hu menif. molich umevi maale umorid. veim haya hakkarban toda lokeach min hallechem habba immah echad measara umannicho im hechaze vehashshok vehaemurim umenif hakkol al yede habbealim kemo shebbearnu:
Vechetzad mannichan al yede habbealim. noten et hachalavim al yede habbealim vechaze veshok lemala ushete hakkelayot veyoteret hakkaved lemala mehem. veim yesh sham lechem mannicho lemala umenif hakkol:
Haya hakkarban el nazir motzi haemurin umafrish chaze veshok umevashshel shear haayil beezrat hannashim. velokeach hakkohen hazzeroa beshela min haayil im echad measara min hallechem habba immo im hechaze vehashshok vehaemurin umanniach hakkol al yede hannazir. vehakkohen manniach yadav tachat yede habbealim umenif hakkol kemo shebbearnu:
E zehu chaze kol haroe et hakkarka lemala ad hatztzavvar. lematta ad hakkares. vechotech immah shete tzelaot elach veelach. vee zehu zeroa min happerek shel arkubba ad kaf shel yad shehem shene evarim meorin ze baze. vehazzeroa haamura hi zeroa shel yamin. veshekkenegdah baregel hu hashshok haamur bechol makom:
Veachar shemmenifan moleach haemurin umaktiran al gabbe hammizbeach. aval hechaze vehashshok neechol lakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 34)</small> "ki et chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma". ushear hashshelamim neechalim labbealim. veen hakkohanim zochin bechaze veshok ella leachar hekter haemurin:
Vechen hallechem shemmenif betoda uveel nazir vehazzeroa habbeshela neechalin lakkohanim. ushear hallechem im shear habbasar neechol labbealim. vehallechem shemmenif im hechaze vehashshok hem hannikrain muram mittoda. vehazzeroa beshela im hechaze vehashshok im hallechem shemmenif hem hannikrain muram meel nazir:
Hallechem hammuram min hattoda sefek teruma hu. lefichach en chayyavin alav mita vechomesh kitruma veeno medammea kitruma:
Haya baal hattoda kohen. hare shear hallechem neechol labbealim ketodat yisrael. sheen hallechem habba im hattoda o im el nazir karuy mincha:
Shenayim sheheviu shelamim beshuttafut haechad menif birshut chavero afillu hem mea echad menif al yede kullan. ma sheen ken bismicha:
Hayta ishsha baalat hakkarban enah menifa. aval hakkohen menif shekkarbanah taun tenufa vehi pesula litnufa. uleolam en ishsha menifa ella hassota vehannezira bilvad kemo shebbearnu. utenufa kodemet lehaggasha bechol makom:
Ketzad hu hallechem shemmevi im hattoda. lokeach esrim issaron solet veose mehem asara esronim chametz vaasara matztza. haasara shel chametz ose otam eser challot:
Vechetzad mechammetzan. mevi seor kede chimmutzan venotno letoch hammidda umemalle et hammidda af al pi shessofah lihyot chasera o yetera mippene hasseor sheppeamim yihye ave vekashe ufeamim rakka en mashgichin ella al middatah atta vahare hu moded issaron issaron shelamim. vehaasara esronim shel matztza ose mehen sheloshim challot shavot. eser challot mikkol min. eser challot maafe tannur. veeser challot rekikim. veeser challot murbechet:
Vechetzad hi hammurbechet. choltah berotchin veofe otah meat veachar kach kole otah beshemen al hailpas vechayyotze bo. kederech shekkolin hassufganin. umarbin beshamnah. vezehu haribbuch haamur bechol makom:
Uvechamma shemen hu ose hashsheloshim challot. bachatzi log shemen. veshiur ze halacha lemoshe missinay. reviit mimmennu lirvucha. usheminit lechallot. usheminit lirkikin:
Hachallot lotet hassolet shellahen bishminit shel shemen. veachar kach lash veofe otan. veharkikin moshchan bashsheminit shellahen achar afiyyatan. vehakkohen lokeach min hakkol arba challot achat mikkol min umin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 14)</small> "echad mikkol karban":
Velachme toda sheafa otan arba challot yatza. lo neemar arbaim ella lemitzva. vehu sheyyafrish hachalla shellahen achat mikkol karban keshehen batzek. sheen mafrishin perusa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 14)</small> "echad mikkol karban" shello yittol parus:
Vechetzad hu hallechem habba im el nazir. lokeach shishsha esronot ushene shelishe issaron veose mehen esrim challot shavot vehakkol matztza. asara rekikin meshuchin beshemen. veeser challot lotet hassolet shellahen beshemen. vehakkol maafe tannur veshemen shellahen reviit. veshiur ze halacha lemoshe missinay. vehakkohen lokeach mehen shete challot achat mikkol min:
Shene mine lechem shebbenazir vearbaa mine lechem shebbetoda meakkevin ze et ze. umaase hallechem shel shenehen chutz laazara:
Ketzad maase habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach. achar shezzorek daman kemo shebbearnu mafshit umotzi haemurim umolchan umaktiran. ushear besar habbechor neechol lakkohanim. ushear besar hammaaser neechol labbealim. ushear happesach neechol limnuyav kehilchotav kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot happesach:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 10:
Achilat hachattat vehaasham mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 33)</small> "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem". hakkohanim ochlim uvealim mitkapperim. vehu haddin lishar hakkadashim sheochlin otan hakkohanim sheachilatan mitzva:
Vechen achilat sheyare menachot mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 9)</small> "vehannoteret mimmenna yochlu aharon uvanav":
Veen chattat veasham usheyare menachot neechalin ella lezichre kehunna baazara veim neechlu bahechol neechlu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 9)</small> "lechol minchatam ulechol chattatam ulechol ashamam" <small>(Bamidbar 18 10)</small> "bekodesh hakodashim tochlennu kol zachar yochal oto". vechen shalme tzibbur hare hen kachattat vechaasham kemo shebbearnu:
Chaze veshok shel shelamim neechalin lechohanim zecharim unekevot shenneemar bahem <small>(Bamidbar 18 11)</small> "lecha netattim ulevanecha velivnotecha". vechen hammuram mittoda vehammuram meel nazir shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 19)</small> "kl terumot hakodashim asher yarimu vene yisrael laAdonai natatti lecha ulevanecha velivnotecha":
Vechen habbechor shehare neemar bo <small>(Bamidbar 18 18)</small> "uvesaram yihye lach kachaze hattenufa ucheshok hayyamin". vechol ellu hanneechalim lakkohanot neechalim leavde hakkohanim velinshehem kitruma. vechullan neechalim bechol hair shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 14)</small> "et chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma tochlu bemakom tahor" lo neemar bahen bemakom kadosh shehi haazara ella tahor shehu kol machane yisrael shekkenegdo ledorot yerushalayim. vehu haddin lemaaser ufesach shehare hen kadashim kallim kishlamim. vehachallonot voovi hachoma kilfanim:
Hashshelamim neechalim beyom hazzevicha vechol hallayla vechol yom hammochorat ad shettishka hachamma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 16)</small> "beyom hakerivo et zivcho yeachel umimmochorat" <small>(Vayikra 7 18)</small> "veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav bayyom hashshelishi" vegomer. nimtzeta lamed shehen neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad ben chelek hakkohanim ben chelek habbealim vehu haddin livchor umaaser shehare hen kadashim kallim kishlamim:
Aval hattoda af al pi shehi kadashim kallim enah neechelet ella beyom hazzevicha im hallayla shenneemar bah <small>(Vayikra 7 15)</small> "beyom karbano yeachel lo yanniach mimmennu ad boker". vechen el nazir vehallechem habba immahen vechayyotze bahen ben chelek hakkohanim ben chelek habbealim vehu haddin lechattat uleasham uleshalme tzibbur velishyare menachot shehakkol neechol leyom velayla shenneemar beyom karbano yeachel kol hakkarbanot bemashma chutz min hashshelamim shepperesh bahen hakkatuv uvechor umaaser haddomim lahem: 
Kol ellu hanneechalin leyom velayla din tora shehen neechalin ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar uchede leharechik min haavera amru chachamim sheen neechalin ella ad chatzot hallayla:
Kol hakkarbanot ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim en ochlin otam ella hattehorim bilvad hammulin. afillu heeriv shimsho velo hevi kapparato eno ochel bekadashim. vehattumtum asur leechol bekadashim lefi shehu sefek arel aval haanderoginus yerae li sheochel bekadashim kallim:
Umuttar leechol et hakkadashim bechol maachol. afillu hakkohanim muttarin leechol chelkam ben mikkadashim kallim ben mikkadshe kadashim bechol maachol. uleshannot baachilatan uleachlam tzeluyim shelukim umevushshalim velatet letochan tavlin shel chullin aval lo tavlin shel teruma shello yaviu et hatteruma lide pissul. vehaatzamot hannisharot muttarot veose adam mehem kol kelim sheyyirtze:
Hayta lahem achila muetet ochlin immah chullin uterumot kede shettihye neechelet im hassova. hayta lahen achila merubba en ochlin immah chullin uteruma kede shello tihye neechelet achila gassa. vechen bishyare hammenachot:
En mevashshelin chattat o asham im muram mittoda o meel nazir mippene shemmemaet beochlehen uvimkom achilatan. velo muram mittoda umeel nazir im bechor o im chaze veshok shel shelamim mippene shemmemaet zeman achilatan. velo muram mishshelamim shel emesh im chattat veasham shel yom mippene shemmemaet beochlehen uvimkom achilatan uvizman achilatan. aval chattat veasham mitbashshelin ze im ze vetoda veel nazir ze im ze vehabbechor vechaze veshok ze im ze. chaticha shel kadshe kadashim o shel piggul o notar shennitbashshela im chatichot acherot. otan hachatichot asurot lezarim umuttarot lakkohanim:
Besar kadshe kadashim o besar kadashim kallim shennitbashshel im besar taava hare besar hattaava asur litmeim umuttar lithorim:
Neemar beola <small>(Vayikra 7 8)</small> "or haola asher hikriv lakkohen lo yihye". veneemar bechattat <small>(Vayikra 6 19)</small> "hakkohen hamechatte otah yochlenna". veneemar beasham <small>(Vayikra 7 7)</small> "hakkohen asher yechapper bo lo yihye". veneemar bishlamim <small>(Vayikra 7 14)</small> "lakkohen hazzorek et dam hashshelamim lo yihye". veneemar bemincha <small>(Vayikra 7 9)</small> "hakkohen hammakriv otah lo yihye". en hakkatuv medabber bechol ellu ella berauy. shehakkohen harauy laavoda zehu sheyyesh lo chelek leechol. umi sheeno rauy bishat hakkarban kegon shehaya tame en lo chelek leechol afillu kesheyyithar laerev. aval leinyan chaluka hakkol leanshe bet av shemmakrivin beoto hayyom. vechullam cholkim bechol kadshe hammikdash ish keachiv. ben ze shehikriv ben achiv sheimmo bammikdash shello hikriv:
Velamma chillek hakkatuv bimnachot ben menachot haafuyot uminchat hassolet. shehare baafuyot hu omer <small>(Vayikra 7 9)</small> "kol hammincha asher teafe battannur lakkohen hammakriv otah lo tihye". uveminchat hassolet hu omer <small>(Vayikra 7 10)</small> "vechol mincha velula vashshemen vachareva lechol bene aharon tihye ish keachiv". shehaafuya keshecholkin otah anshe bet av kol sheyyaggia lo chelko afillu kezayit pat hare hu rauy lo shehare ochlo miyyad. aval hassolet im yechallekuha benehen nimtza maggia laze melo kappo solet o pachot sheeno rauy lo lalush oto velo leefoto lefichach haya ole al haddaat sheyyachleku mincha keneged mincha velo yachleku mincha zo bifne atzmah al kol anshe bet av. hutzrach hakkatuv lomar bah lechol bene aharon tihye ish keachiv lomar sheyyechallekuha bifne atzmah. mikkan amru chachamim en cholkin mincha keneged mincha afillu maase machavat keneged maase machavat o solet keneged solet. ella kol achat veachat cholkin sheyareha bifne atzmah: 
Vechen en cholkin of keneged of. velo chattat keneged chattat. velo chaze veshok keneged chaze veshok. ella kol chelek vechelek cholkin oto benehen beshave:
En hakkatan cholek afillu bekadashim kallim af al pi shemmuttar lehaachilo kadshe kadashim. vechen ishsha veanderoginus en cholkin lahem bekadshe hammikdash kelal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 10)</small> "ish keachiv". aval baal mum ben kavua ben over ben shennolad bemumo ben shehaya tamim venifsal cholek veochel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 22)</small> "lechem elohav mikkadshe hakodashim" vegomer. vehu sheyyihye rauy laachila. aval im haya tame eno cholek leechol laerev:
Vechohen gadol ochel shello bachaluka ella notel kol ma sheyyirtze:
Kol harauy laachilat hakkadashim bishat hakkarban cholek leechol. vechol mi sheeno rauy leechol bishat haavoda af al pi shehu rauy laavoda vahare hu rauy leechol laerev eno cholek kede lehaniach chelko laerev. ketzad. tevul yom umechussar kippurim vehaonen beyom hakkevura ben kohen gadol ben kohen hedyot en cholkin leechol laerev:
Kol sheeno rauy leechol eno rauy laavod. chutz mikkohen gadol haonen shehu makriv veeno ochel kemo shebbearnu. vechol sheeno rauy laavod eno rauy leechol chutz mibbaal mum shehare nitparesh battora:
Kol sheen lo chelek babbasar en lo chelek baorot. afillu tame bishat zerikat damim vetahor bishat hekter chalavim eno cholek babbasar shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 33)</small> "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev mibbene aharon lo tihye shok hayyamin lemana". ad sheyyihye tahor verauy laavoda mishsheat zerika ad achar hekter chalavim:
Nitma achar zerika vetaval vahare hu tahor af bishat hekter chalavim haddavar safek im cholek im eno cholek lefichach im tafas en motziin miyyado:
Karban tzibbur habba betuma af al pi shehattemeim makrivin oto en cholkin im hattehorin leechol laerev mippene sheenam reuyim laachila:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 11:
Kol haochel kezayit mibbesar haola ben lifni zerikat damah ben leachar zerikat damah loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "vechol nedarecha asher tiddor". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara leochel besar haola:
Vechelbah uvesarah vesaltah veshamnah veyayin shel nesacheha chamishshetan mitztarfin lichzayit:
Vechen haochel kezayit mikkol haemurin ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika ben kohen ben yisrael loke. shehaemurin kalil lammizbeach kechol haola vahare neemar beminchat kohanim <small>(Vayikra 6 16)</small> "kalil tihye lo teachel" kol shehu kalil lammizbeach achilato belo taase velokin alav bichzayit. vechen haochel kezayit mibbesar chattaot hannisrafot loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 23)</small> "vechol chattat asher yuva middamah el ohel moed" <small>(Vayikra 6 23)</small> "lo teachel baesh tissaref":
Kol haochel kezayit mibbesar hakkadashim afillu kadashim kallim kodem zerikat damam loke. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha" <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "venidvotecha". kelomar lo tuchal leechol nidvotecha bisharecha kodem shezzorkin daman beshaare hammakom. mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara leochel toda o shelamim kodem zerikat damim. vehu haddin lishar kadashim ben kallim ben chamurim. veshishsha devarim shebbetoda shehem hachelev vehabbasar vehassolet vehashshemen vehayyayin vehallechem kullan mitztarfin lichzayit:
Kol haochel kezayit mibbesar kadshe kadashim chutz laazara loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara leochel mibbesar chattaot vaashamot chutz laazara. vehu haddin leochel kadashim kallim chutz lirushalayim shehu loke. shechomat yerushalayim lekadashim kallim kechomat haazara lekadshe kadashim. veechad besar chattat veasham o sheyare menachot:
Besar kadshe kadashim sheyyatza chutz lechomat haazara uvesar kadashim kallim sheyyatza chutz lechomat yerushalayim nifsal veneesar leolam. veaf al pi shechazar limkomo asur leachlo vehaochel mimmennu kezayit loke. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu". kevan sheyyatza basar chutz limchitzato naasa kitrefa kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot:
Nichnas besar kadashim kallim lahechol hare ze kasher:
Zar sheachal kezayit mibbesar kadshe kadashim baazara achar zerikat damim loke. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 33)</small> "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem" vegomer <small>(Shemot 29 33)</small> "vezar lo yochal" vegomer. bemakom shehakkohen ochel uveet sherauy leechol im achalo sham hazzar loke. aval im achal hazzar besar kadshe kadashim bachutz loke mishshum ochel bachutz lo mishshum zar sheachal kodesh. shehare enam reuyin sham lakkohanim. vechen im achalan baazara kodem zerika loke mishshum ochel kodem zerika bilvad lo mishshum zarut:
Zar sheachal kezayit mechattat haof loke shetayim. achat mishshum zar sheachal et hakkodesh. veachat mishshum ochel nevela. shekkol melika nevela hi ucheshehuttera lakkohanim huttera lo lezarim. vahare hen shene issurin habbain keechad kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 12:
Hammennachot hem min hakkarbanot. vehammenachot habbaot bifne atzman vienan baot mishshum nesachim. mehem minchat tzibbur. umehem minchat yachid:
Vechol hammenachot solet chittin chutz mimminchat sota veomer hattenufa shehem min hasseorim:
Shalosh menachot latztzibbur. omer hattenufa vehu karev lammizbeach kemo sheyyitbaer. ushete hallechem shemmeviin beyom atzeret. veellu nikreu mincha veenan kerevin legabbe hammizbeach vehen chametz. vaalehem neemar <small>(Vayikra 2 12)</small> "karban reshit takrivu otam laAdonai veel hammizbeach lo yaalu". vehammincha hashshelishit hu lechem happanim sheosin bechol shabbat veeno karev legabbe hammizbeach ella kullo neechol lakkohanim kemo sheyyitbaer:
Vetesha minchot hayyachid vechullan kerevin lammizbeach veellu hen. minchat chote vehu hammincha shemmakriv heani kesheyyitchayyev chattat velo taggia yado. minchat sota vehi minchat hakkenaot shekkevar nitparshu maaseha. hammincha shemmakriv kol kohen techilla kesheyyikkanes laavoda shemmakriv otah beyado vehi hannikret minchat chinnuch. hammincha shemmakriv kohen gadol bechol yom vehi hannikret chavitin. minchat hassolet vehi baa beneder unedava. minchat hammachavat vehi baa beneder unedava. minchat hammarcheshet vehi baa beneder unedava. minchat maafe tannur vehi baa beneder unedava. minchat rekikin vehi baa beneder unedava:
Kol hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach en kol achat mehen pechuta meissaron. umiuto meakkev et kullo. vechamesh menachot habbaot beneder unedava yesh lo lehitnaddev velindor mehen kol ma sheyyirtze afillu elef issaron. aval minchat haomer uminchat chote uminchat kenaot uminchat chinnuch vehachavitin kol achat mehen issaron echad lo pachot velo yeter:
Kol hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach teunot haggasha bamaarav keneged chuddah shel keren deromit maaravit. veenan teunot tenufa. chutz mimminchat sota veomer hattenufa sheshshenehen teunot tenufa vehaggasha:
Kol hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach teunot shemen ulevona. log shemen lechol issaron. vekometz levona lechol mincha. ben shehayta issaron echad ben shehayta shishshim esronim. sheen meviin bichli echad yeter al shishshim issaron kemo sheyyitbaer. chutz mimminchat kenaot uminchat chote shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 11)</small> "lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona":
Natan vehikriv loke al hashshemen bifne atzmo veal hallevona bifne atzmah. natan keli sheyyesh bo shemen o levona al gabbeha eno over velo pasal. minchat chinnuch vehachavitin mosif lechol achat mehen shemen kemo sheyyitbaer:
Kol hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach nikmatzot umaktir hakkometz kullo al gabbe hammizbeach vehashshear neechol lakkohanim chutz mimminchat zichre kehunna sheenah nikmetzet ella maktirin otah kullah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 16)</small> "vechol minchat kohen" vegomer. ha lamadta shemminchat chinnuch vehachavitin vechohen shehevi minchat chote o minchat nedava kullan nisrafot al gabbe hammizbeach veenan nikmatzot:
Hakkohenet minchatah nikmetzet keminchat yisrael usheyareha neechalin:
Veladot shennitarvu vahare kol echad mehen safek minchatam nikmetzet keminchat yisrael veenah neechelet keminchat kohanim. ketzad osim. hakkometz karev bifne atzmo vehashsheyarim mitpazzerin al bet haddeshen:
Kol hannesuot lakkohanim ben kohenet ben yisreelit en sheyare minchotehen neechalim mippene chelek habbaal sheeno ochel. veenah kullah laishshim mippene chelek haishsha. ella hakkometz karev leatzmo vehashsheyarim mitpazzerin al bet haddeshen. hakkemitza bechol makom baazara veim kamatz bahechol keshera:
Umekaddeshin mincha bichli sheal gabbe karka vekomtzin mikkeli sheal gabbe karka. veen makdishin hakkometz bichli sheal gabbe karka. umeematay yutteru hashsheyarim baachila mishsheyyatztzit haur berov hakkometz:
Kol hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach matztza. vechen sheyare hammenachot sheochlin hakkohanim af al pi shehen muttarin leachlan bechol maachol uvidvash en ochlin otan chametz shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 10)</small> "lo teafe chametz chelkam". afillu chelkam lo yachmitzu. veim hechmitz sheyareha loke. vehamechammetz achar hamechammetz chayyav. velokin al kol asiyya vaasiyya shebbah:
Ketzad. lashah chametz o arachah chametz o ketafah chametz o afaah chametz loke. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2 11)</small> "lo tease chametz" veneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 10)</small> "lo teafe chametz" lechayyev al kol maase yechidi shebbah. asa chametz mittechilla vead sof loke al kol maase mehen:
Hinniach seor al gabbe haissa vehalach veyashav lo venitchammetza meeleha loke. shehannachat hasseor hu hammaase:
Tibbel hashsheyarim beketzach o beshumshemin o bechol mine tavlin ushemanim keshera. matztza hi ella shennikret matztza metubbelet:
Hamechammetz mincha pesula patur. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2 11)</small> "asher takrivu laAdonai lo tease chametz". hakkesherah lehashshem lo happesula. chimmetzah keshehi keshera veyatzat lachutz vechazar vechimmetzah achar shennifsela bitziatah eno loke. chimmetzah berosho shel mizbeach eno loke shenneemar asher takrivu uchevar karva zo vehi keshera: 
Hamechammetz lechem happanim loke. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2 11)</small> "kol hammincha". aval minchat nesachim en bah malkot sheim gibbelah bemayim hare nifsela kodem shettitchammetz. veim gibbelah beyayin shel nesachim me perot hen veen machmitzin:
Hachittim shel menachot en lottin otan shemma yachmitzu shehare bachutz lottin otan veen hakkol zerizin leshamran. aval minchat haomer hoil vehi shel tzibbur lottin otah. shehare hatztzibbur zerizin hen umeshammerin otah:
Kol hammenachot hanneefot nilloshot befoshrin umeshammeran shello yachmitzu. hoil velishatan vaafiyyatan bifnim baazara anshe penim zerizin hen:
Uvemakom shemmevashshelin kadshe kadashim sham ofin et hammenachot shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 46 20)</small> "ze hammakom asher yevashshelu sham hakkohanim et haasham veet hachattat asher yofu et hammincha" vegomer:
Kol hammenachot techinatan veharekadatan bachutz. velishatan vaarichatan vaafiyyatan bifnim. vechol maasehen kesherim bezar ad sheyyavou levet hakkemitza. umachavat umarcheshet hayu baazara. ushetehem mikkele hashsharet umekaddeshin. vetannur shel mikdash shel mattechet haya:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 13:
Mitzvat ase laasot kol mincha kemitzvatah haamura battora:
Vechetzad asiyyat chavite kohen gadol. mevi issaron shalem umakdisho vechotzehu bachatzi issaron shebbammikdash sheaf al pi shehi kereva chetzyan enah mitkaddeshet lechetzyan. umevi immah sheloshet login shemen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 14)</small> "bashshemen tease" lehosif lah shemen keniske hakkeves. uvolel hassolet beshemen vecholtah berotchin. velash mikkol chatzi issaron shesh challot. nimtzeu shetem esre challot:
Veachat achat hayu naasot. vechetzad ose. mechallek hashshelosha login birviit shebbammikdash. reviit lechol challa. veofah hachalla meat veachar kach kole otah al hammachavat bishar reviit hashshemen shellah. veeno mevashshelah harebe shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 14)</small> "tufine" ben bashel vena:
Veachar kach cholek kol challa vechalla lishnayim beomed. kede sheyyakriv hachetzi babboker vehachetzi baerev velokeach hachatzayim vechofel kol echad mehen lishnayim ufotet ad shettimmatze kol petita kefula lishnayim. umakriv hachatzayin im chatzi kometz levona babboker vehachetzi hannishar im chatzi kometz levona baerev. veim hayta minchat chinnuch eno chotze ella makrivah kullah keachat im kometz levona ushetehen kalil laishshim:
Minchat hassolet ketzad hayta naaset. mevi issaron solet o kamma esronot o kefi nidro veshemen harauy lah umoded beissaron shel mikdash. venoten shemen bichli. veachar kach noten alav et hassolet. veachar kach noten shemen acher al hassolet uvolel hassolet bo. veachar kach notnah bichli sharet vetzak letochah shemen. veshemen shennatan techilla im hashshemen habbalul im shemen sheyyatzak hakkol log leissaron venoten aleha levonatah:
Minchat hammachavat vehammarcheshet ketzad. noten hashshemen bichli venoten alav hassolet. venoten al hassolet shemen acher uvolel hassolet veachar kach lashah befoshrin veofe otah bemachavat o bammarcheshet kemo shennadar. ufotet otah pittim venotnah bichli sharet veyotzek aleha shear hashshemen venoten levonatah:
Ma ben machavat lemarcheshet. marcheshet yesh lah safa vehabbatzek sheofin oto aleha rach shehare yesh lah safa veeno yotze. umachavat en lah safa vehabbatzek sheofin oto bah kashe kede shello yetze mikkan umikkan:
Minchat maafe tannur ketzad. im challot hi bolel hassolet beshemen velash befoshrin veofe ufotet venoten bichli sharet venoten aleha levonatah veen bah yetzikat shemen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2 4)</small> "challot matztzot belulot bashshemen". veim rekikin hi lash et hassolet befoshrin umosheach et harkikin beshemen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2 4)</small> "urekike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen". veyerae li sheachar afiyya mosheach otam:
Vechetzad moshchan. mevi log shemen lechol issaron umoshchan vechozer umoshchan ad sheyyichle kol hashshemen shabballog:
Kol arba menachot ellu haafuyot. kesheofin otan ofin kol issaron eser challot. veim ribba bechallot o chisser keshera. vechetzad pottin otan. kofel hachalla lishnayim vehashshenayim learbaa umavdil. veim hayta hammincha shel zichre kehunna eno mavdil ufotet. vechullan petitin kezetim. veim higdil happetitin o hiktin otan kesherim:
Lo balal lo patat lo higgish lo mashach et harkikin keshera. lo neemru kol haddevarim haellu ella lemitzva shekkach hi mitzvatah:
Seder havaat hammincha ketzad. mevi adam solet mittoch beto biklatot shel kesef o shel zahav o shel shear mine mattachot keli shehu rauy lichle sharet. veim hayta minchat hassolet notnah lichli sharet umekaddeshah bichli sharet. veim hayta min hammenachot hanneefot ofe otah sham bammikdash ufotet kemo shebbearnu venoten happetitin lichli sharet venoten aleha shamnah ulevonatah umolichah etzel kohen. vehakkohen molichah etzel hammizbeach umaggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren vedayyo. umesallek et kol levonatah letzad echad vekometz mimmakom shennitrabba shamnah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2 2)</small> "missaltah umishshamnah". venoten hakkometz lichli sharet umekaddesho bichli sharet. vekometz shechilleko bishne kelim eno kadosh. vechozer umekaddesh umelakket et kol levonatah venotnah al hakkometz shebbakkeli umaalehu al hammizbeach umolcho. venotno al gabbe haishshim mikkeli sharet. veim minchat kohanim hi eno kometz ella noten melach al kullah umashlich hakkol al gabbe haishshim:
Ketzad komtzin menachot hannikmatzot. kederech shekkometz kol haadam poshet etzbeotav al pas yado vekometz. kamatz berashe etzbeotav o min hatztzedadin lo yaktir veim hiktir hurtza. veim hosif bakkometz kegon shehirchik etzbeotav vekamatz hare ze pasul:
En kometz pachot mikkishne zetim. umiktzat hakkometz meakkev et kullo. vehakkometz vehallevona meakkevin ze et ze. hassolet vehashshemen meakkevin ze et ze umiktzat hashshemen meakkev et kullo. en pachot millog leissaron kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 14: Mitnaddev adam venoder ola ushelamim vechol min sheyyirtze mechamishsha mine menachot habbain beneder unedava. umitnaddev o noder mincha mimminchat nesachim levaddah mee ze min mishshelosha mine menachot nesachim kemo shebbearnu. umitnaddev o noder yayin bifne atzmo o levona bifne atzmah o shemen bifne atzmo o etzim lammaaracha mippene shehen kekarban shenneemar <small>(Nechemya 13 lo)</small> "ulekurban haetzim":
Shenayim mitnaddevin o nodrin karban echad ola o shelamim afillu pereda achat shel torim o bene yona meviin otah beshuttafut. aval hammincha enah baa beshuttafut. udevarim ellu hen divre kabbala:
Heniach mincha lishne banav umet hare ellu meviin otah:

E ze hu neder vee zo hi nedava. haomer hare alay ola o hare alay shelamim o hare alay mincha o hare deme behema zo alay ola o shelamim zehu hanneder. aval haomer hare behema zo o deme behema zo ola o shelamim o hare haissaron hazze mincha hare zo nedava:
Ma ben nedarim lindavot. shehannoder im hifrish karbano veavad o nignav chayyav beacharayuto ad sheyyakriv kemo shennadar. vehammitnaddev veomer zo im met o nignav eno chayyav beacharayuto:
Haomer deme shor ze alay ola udeme bayit ze alay karban umet hashshor venafal habbayit chayyav leshallem. amar hare alay ola al menat shello etchayyev beacharayutah eno chayyav beacharayutah:

Kevar bearnu shehaose bayit chutz lammikdash lehakeriv bo karbanot eno kevet avoda zara vehaomer hare alay ola sheakrivenna bammikdash vehikrivah bevayit ze lo yatza. sheakrivenna bevayit ze vehikrivah bammikdash yatza. veim hikrivah beoto habbayit yatza. hare hu kemi shennadar ola al menat shello yitchayyev beacharayutah veanush karet al haalayatah bachutz. vechen im amar hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach bevayit ze. im gilleach sham yatza. hare hu kemi shennadar letzaer atzmo vahare tzier atzmo veenah nezirut:

Chattat veasham enan bain ella al chet. veenan bain beneder unedava. haomer hare alay chattat o asham o sheamar hare zo chattat o asham lo amar kelum. haya mechuyyav chattat o asham veamar hare zo lechattati o laashami o hare hammaot haellu lechattati o laashami devarav kayyamim:
Haomer karban metzora ze o yoledet zo alay. im haya oto metzora o hayyoledet aniyyim mevi hannoder karban ani. veim hayu ashirim mevi hannoder karban ashir af al pi shehannoder ani:

Haomer chattato veolato vaashamo ushelamav shel peloni alay. im ratza oto peloni hare ze menicho lehakerivan al yado umitkapper lo. ratza bishat haferasha velo ratza bishat hakerava ella chazar bo. beola uvishlamim makrivin umitkapper lo bahen af al pi sheeno rotze atta shehare ratza bishat haferasha. aval bechattat uveasham lo nitkapper lo ad sheyyirtze mittechilla vead sof:

Haomer hare alay kenidre reshaim shemminnidrehen nazir vekarban ushevua chayyav bechullan. kenidre kesherin lo nitchayyev kelum. hare alay kindavot kesherin hare ze nadar benazir uvekarban. vechol kinnuye karban kekarban:

En hannoder velo hammitnaddev chayyav ad sheyyehe piv velibbo shavin. ketzad. hammitkavven lomar hare alay ola veamar shelamim. o shennitkavven lomar hare zo ola veamar shelamim lo amar kelum. nitkavven lindor beola veamar karban. lindor becherem veamar hekdesh devarav kayyamim. shehaola karban vehacherem hekdesh. vechen kol kayyotze baze. bindarim unedavot eno tzarich lehotzi bisfatav kelum ella im gamar belibbo velo hotzi bisfatav kelum chayyav. ketzad. gamar belibbo shezzo ola o sheyyavi ola hare ze chayyav lehavi shenneemar <small>(Shemot la 5)</small> "kl nediv lev yeviah" bindivut lev yitchayyev lehavi. vechen kol kayyotze baze minnidre kadashim venidvutan:

Echad nedarim unedavot im shear haddevarim sheadam chayyav bahen mearachin vedamim umaasrot umattenot aniyyim mitzvat ase min hattora sheyyavi hakkol baregel sheppaga bo techilla shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 5)</small> "uvata shamma" <small>(Devarim 12 6)</small> "vahavetem shamma" vegomer kelomar beet shettavo lachog tavi kol ma sheatta chayyav bo vetitten kol chov shealecha lashshem. higgia haregel velo hevi hare ze bittel mitzvat ase. avru alav shelosha regalim velo hevi karbenotav shennadar o hitnaddev o shello natan haarachim vehacharamim vehaddamim hare ze avar belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 22)</small> "lo teacher leshallemo" eno over belo taase ad sheyyaavru alav ragle hashshana kullah. veen lokin al lav ze lefi sheen bo maase:

Hikdish behema lammizbeach veavru alav shene regalim venafal bah mum ufedaah al gav behema acheret eno over belo taase ad sheyyaavru al haacheret shelosha regalim. veechad haish veechad haishsha over beval teacher. aval hayyoresh eno over beval teacher:

Kol hakkarbanot sheavru alehen shelosha regalim lo nifselu. ella makrivan uchesherim. uvechol yom veyom achar hashshelosha regalim hu over belo teacher. uvet din metzuvvin leassoto miyyad ad sheyyakriv karbenotav baregel sheppaga bo techilla:
Af al pi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 3)</small> "lirtzono" kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani. ben shennadar velo hifrish ben shehifrish velo hikriv kofin oto ad sheyyakriv:

Kol chayyave olot ushelamim memashkenin otam. af al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyirtze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 3)</small> "lirtzono" kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani. aval chayyave chattaot vaashamot en memashkenin otan hoil vehem meukkeve kappara en choshshin lahem shemma yifsheu veyashhu karbenotehen. chutz mechattat nazir hoil veenah meakkavto millishtot yayin shemma yeacher otah lefichach memashkenin oto aleha:
